en: to officially end a law, rule, or system
simple: They want to abolish the old rule.
simple_zh: 他們想廢除那項舊規定。
toeic: The board voted to abolish the outdated expense approval process.
toeic_zh: 董事會投票決定廢除過時的費用核准流程。

en: using careful study and logic to understand something
simple: She has a very analytic mind.
simple_zh: 她的頭腦非常善於分析。
toeic: The firm hired a manager with strong analytic skills to review sales trends.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請了一位分析能力強的經理來檢視銷售趨勢。

en: a number or answer that is close to the exact one but not exact
simple: This number is only an approximation.
toeic: The finance team gave us a rough approximation of next year's budget.
toeic_zh: 財務團隊給了我們明年預算的粗略估計。

en: an official in a government or large organization who follows rules strictly
simple: The bureaucrat checked every form twice.
simple_zh: 那位官員把每份表格檢查了兩次。
toeic: A local bureaucrat approved the building permit after several weeks.
toeic_zh: 一位地方官員在數週後核准了建築許可。

en: involving too many rules and slow official procedures
simple: The process is slow and bureaucratic.
simple_zh: 這個流程既緩慢又繁瑣。
toeic: Bureaucratic delays held up approval of the new factory for months.
toeic_zh: 官僚作風造成的延誤使新工廠的核准拖了好幾個月。

en: to bring control or activities into one place or group
simple: They will centralize all the records.
simple_zh: 他們會把所有紀錄集中管理。
toeic: The company decided to centralize its purchasing in one regional office.
toeic_zh: 公司決定把採購集中在一個區域辦公室。

en: the act or process of calculating a number or answer
simple: The computation took only a minute.
simple_zh: 這項計算只花了一分鐘。
toeic: An error in the computation caused the invoice total to be wrong.
toeic_zh: 計算上的錯誤導致發票總額有誤。
family: compute (v); computational (adj); computer (n); error in computation

en: to use computers to do or control something
simple: We will computerize the old files.
simple_zh: 我們會把舊檔案電腦化。
toeic: The clinic plans to computerize its patient records by next spring.
toeic_zh: 診所計畫在明年春天前將病歷電腦化。

en: to move power or activities away from one central place
simple: They decentralize the decision process.
simple_zh: 他們把決策過程分散到各地。
toeic: The firm chose to decentralize its customer support across three regional offices.
toeic_zh: 公司選擇將客服分散到三個區域辦公室。

en: a number written with a point, like 0.5
simple: Write the decimal after the dot.
simple_zh: 把小數寫在小數點後面。
toeic: Please round the result to two decimal places in the report.
toeic_zh: 請在報告中將結果四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

en: to plan or invent a new way of doing something
simple: She wants to devise a simple game.
simple_zh: 她想設計一個簡單的遊戲。
toeic: The team will devise a new strategy to cut shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 團隊將擬定新策略以降低運費。
family: device (n) 裝置; devise (v) 設計想出

en: in the correct or expected way and at the right time
simple: He duly arrived at nine.
toeic: Please sign the form, and it will be duly processed by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在表格上簽名，我們將於週五前依規定辦理。

en: to use strength, influence or effort
simple: He had to exert great effort.
simple_zh: 他必須付出很大的努力。
toeic: Major shareholders can exert pressure on the board of directors.
toeic_zh: 大股東可以對董事會施加壓力。

en: to have the main office of a company in a place
simple: Our firm is headquartered in Taipei.
simple_zh: 我們公司的總部設在台北。
toeic: The software company is headquartered in Singapore and employs 800 staff.
toeic_zh: 這家軟體公司總部設在新加坡，雇用八百名員工。

en: suggested but not said directly
simple: There was an implicit threat.
toeic: The contract contains an implicit agreement to renew each year.
toeic_zh: 這份合約含有每年續約的默示協議。

en: growing in small steps
simple: We made incremental progress.
toeic: The firm prefers incremental improvements to large, risky changes.
toeic_zh: 這家公司偏好漸進式改善，而非冒險的大幅變革。

en: the study of a whole economy, such as inflation and jobs
simple: She studies macroeconomics at university.
simple_zh: 她在大學學總體經濟學。
toeic: The analyst's knowledge of macroeconomics helped her predict interest rate changes.
toeic_zh: 那位分析師對總體經濟學的了解，幫助她預測利率變動。

en: to do better than someone or something else
simple: Our team can outperform every other team.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊能勝過其他所有團隊。
toeic: Our new product continues to outperform expectations in overseas markets.
toeic_zh: 我們的新產品在海外市場持續超越預期。

en: a good result or reward for effort or investment
simple: Hard work has a big payoff.
toeic: The long training program finally had a payoff when sales doubled.
toeic_zh: 當銷售額翻倍時，漫長的培訓計畫終於有了回報。
family: pay off (v); payoff period; big payoff

en: to announce something publicly and officially
simple: The mayor will proclaim a new holiday.
simple_zh: 市長將宣布一個新的假日。
toeic: The CEO will proclaim the merger at tomorrow's press conference.
toeic_zh: 執行長將在明天的記者會上宣布合併案。

en: a business owned by one person
simple: His shop is a small proprietorship.
simple_zh: 他的店是一間小型獨資企業。
toeic: She registered her bakery as a sole proprietorship to keep paperwork simple.
toeic_zh: 她把麵包店登記為獨資企業，好讓文書作業簡單些。

en: a way of controlling or limiting something
simple: The new boss kept a tight rein.
toeic: The board plans to keep a tight rein on department spending this quarter.
toeic_zh: 董事會打算本季嚴格控管各部門的支出。
family: free rein; keep a tight rein on; rein in (v)

en: a change in how a company or group is arranged
simple: The reorganization changed our office layout.
simple_zh: 這次重組改變了我們的辦公室配置。
toeic: The reorganization of the sales department will be announced on Monday.
toeic_zh: 業務部門的重組將於週一宣布。

en: to control or limit something
simple: Please restrain your dog.
toeic: The department must restrain spending until revenue recovers.
toeic_zh: 在營收回升之前，該部門必須控制支出。

en: the focus on one particular area of work or study
simple: Her specialization is computer science.
simple_zh: 她的專攻領域是資訊科學。
toeic: Greater specialization among staff has improved the quality of service.
toeic_zh: 員工更專業化提升了服務品質。

en: a smaller part of a section in a document
simple: Please read the first subsection.
toeic: Details about the refund policy appear in subsection three.
toeic_zh: 退款政策的細節載於第三小節。

en: a page with questions or tables to fill in
simple: Please fill in this worksheet.
toeic: Enter the monthly figures in the budget worksheet.
toeic_zh: 請將每月的數字填入預算工作表。

en: a change made to fit a new situation; a changed version
simple: The film is an adaptation of a book.
simple_zh: 這部電影是由一本書改編的。
toeic: Quick adaptation to new software is essential for this role.
toeic_zh: 快速適應新軟體對這個職務來說很重要。

en: the way someone or something is described
simple: I liked the characterization in that movie.
simple_zh: 我喜歡那部電影裡的角色刻畫。
toeic: The report's characterization of the market as stable was challenged.
toeic_zh: 報告將市場描述為穩定，這個說法受到質疑。

en: a mark (,) used in writing to separate parts of a sentence
simple: Put a comma after the first word.
simple_zh: 在第一個字後面加一個逗號。
toeic: Please add a comma between the name and the job title in the report.
toeic_zh: 請在報告中的姓名與職稱之間加上逗號。
family: comma splice; insert a comma; punctuation (n)

en: a book that explains the meanings of words
simple: I use a dictionary every day.
toeic: The translator checked a business dictionary before finalizing the contract.
toeic_zh: 譯者在定稿合約前先查閱了商業字典。
family: look up in a dictionary; online dictionary; diction (n)

en: something that interrupts a calm or normal situation
simple: The noise was a disturbance.
toeic: Please avoid any disturbance during the presentation in the main hall.
toeic_zh: 在主廳進行簡報時，請避免任何干擾。

en: in the most basic or important way
simple: The two plans are fundamentally different.
simple_zh: 這兩個計畫在根本上不同。
toeic: The new software has fundamentally changed how our team tracks orders.
toeic_zh: 新軟體從根本上改變了我們團隊追蹤訂單的方式。

en: following the rules of grammar
simple: Your sentence is not grammatical.
toeic: Please fix every grammatical error before sending the letter to clients.
toeic_zh: 在把信寄給客戶之前，請修正所有文法錯誤。

en: a feeling that stops you from doing something freely
simple: He spoke without any inhibition.
toeic: A fear of failure can cause inhibition and slow down the team.
toeic_zh: 對失敗的恐懼可能造成抑制，拖慢團隊的腳步。

en: relating to the words of a language
simple: This lexical test checks new words.
simple_zh: 這個詞彙測驗檢查新單字。
toeic: The software flags any lexical errors in translated manuals.
toeic_zh: 該軟體會標示翻譯手冊中的任何詞彙錯誤。

en: a book or document before it is printed
simple: She wrote a manuscript at home.
toeic: Please submit the final manuscript to the editor by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前將最終稿件交給編輯。

en: a curved bracket ( ) used around extra information
simple: Put your age in parenthesis.
simple_zh: 把你的年齡放在括號裡。
toeic: Enter the area code in parenthesis before the phone number.
toeic_zh: 請在電話號碼前以括號填入區碼。

en: more than one
simple: 'Cats' is a plural word.
toeic: Use the plural form when you refer to several clients.
toeic_zh: 提到多位客戶時，請使用複數形式。

en: to arrange or choose things without any pattern
simple: Please randomize the names.
toeic: The system will randomize the order of the survey questions.
toeic_zh: 系統會將問卷題目的順序隨機排列。

en: a regular pattern of sound or movement
simple: I like the rhythm of this song.
toeic: Remote work has changed the daily rhythm of our office.
toeic_zh: 遠距工作改變了我們辦公室的日常節奏。

en: only one; unusual
simple: 'Child' is a singular word.
toeic: Use a singular verb when the subject is one department.
toeic_zh: 主詞是單一部門時，請使用單數動詞。

en: a long piece of writing for a university degree, or a main argument
simple: She is writing her thesis this month.
toeic: The consultant's thesis is that remote work raises productivity.
toeic_zh: 這位顧問的論點是遠距工作能提高生產力。

en: a long thin piece of cotton or wool; a series of connected messages
simple: She needs a needle and thread.
toeic: Please reply within the same email thread so everyone can follow the discussion.
toeic_zh: 請在同一封郵件串中回覆，讓大家都能跟上討論。
family: email thread; thread of conversation; thread a needle

en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
simple: I cannot cope with this noise.
toeic: Our small team struggled to cope with the sudden rise in orders.
toeic_zh: 我們的小團隊難以應付訂單的突然暴增。

en: a person or thing that is not included in a rule
simple: There is one exception to the rule.
toeic: With the exception of Friday, the office is open every day this week.
toeic_zh: 除了星期五，本週辦公室每天都開放。
family: except (prep); exceptional (adj); with the exception of

en: to make something more modern, or to give the latest information
simple: I need to update my phone.
toeic: Please update the client database with the new contact numbers by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在星期五前以新的聯絡電話更新客戶資料庫。

en: to combine two or more things into one effective whole
simple: We integrate the two apps.
simple_zh: 我們把這兩個應用程式整合在一起。
toeic: The IT department will integrate the payroll system with the HR database.
toeic_zh: 資訊部門將把薪資系統與人資資料庫整合在一起。

en: working well without wasting time or energy
simple: This is an efficient machine.
simple_zh: 這是一台有效率的機器。
toeic: The new filing system is more efficient than the old paper method.
toeic_zh: 新的歸檔系統比舊的紙本方式更有效率。

en: public praise for good work, or the act of knowing something
simple: She got recognition for her good work.
simple_zh: 她的優秀表現獲得了肯定。
toeic: The firm received recognition for its environmental efforts.
toeic_zh: 該公司的環保努力獲得了表揚。
family: recognize (v); in recognition of; brand recognition

en: a basic structure of ideas or rules for planning something
simple: We need a framework for the project.
simple_zh: 我們的計畫需要一個架構。
toeic: The legal framework for the contract is still being discussed.
toeic_zh: 這份合約的法律架構仍在討論中。
family: within the framework of; legal/regulatory framework

en: to give a document or plan to someone for a decision
simple: Please submit your homework on Friday.
simple_zh: 請在週五交出你的作業。
toeic: Employees must submit expense reports by the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 員工必須在月底前提交費用報告。
family: submission (n); submit A to B; submit an application

en: a long period of time known for something
simple: This was a happy era for my town.
simple_zh: 這是我們城鎮的快樂時代。
toeic: The merger marks the start of a new era for the company.
toeic_zh: 這次合併標誌著公司新時代的開始。
family: era of; a new era; digital era

en: for this reason
simple: It rained, hence we stayed home.
simple_zh: 下雨了，因此我們待在家。
toeic: Demand is rising, hence the need for more staff.
toeic_zh: 需求正在上升，因此需要更多人手。

en: the usual way of doing things every day
simple: My morning routine is very simple.
toeic: Routine maintenance is carried out every Monday morning.
toeic_zh: 例行維護在每週一早上進行。

en: to give time or effort to something
simple: She will devote her weekend to study.
toeic: The firm will devote more funds to staff training.
toeic_zh: 公司將投入更多經費在員工培訓上。
family: devotion (n); devoted (adj); devote A to B

en: coming from or related to the outside
simple: The shop has an external door.
toeic: An external auditor will review our accounts next week.
toeic_zh: 外部稽核員下週將審查我們的帳目。

en: an organized set of data stored on a computer
simple: The database has all our names.
simple_zh: 資料庫裡有我們所有人的姓名。
toeic: Please update the customer database before the campaign starts.
toeic_zh: 請在活動開始前更新客戶資料庫。
family: database (n); update/search a database; customer database

en: clear and easy to see; seeming to be true
simple: It is apparent that he is tired.
toeic: It became apparent that the budget would not cover the repairs.
toeic_zh: 很明顯，預算不足以支付維修費用。

en: a base for a service or product; a raised surface
simple: The train leaves from platform two.
toeic: The company launched a new online platform for its customers.
toeic_zh: 公司為客戶推出了新的線上平台。
family: platform (n); online platform; platform fee; train platform

en: a way of doing or operating something
simple: Put your phone in silent mode.
simple_zh: 把你的手機調成靜音模式。
toeic: The printer switches to sleep mode when it is not in use.
toeic_zh: 印表機不使用時會切換到休眠模式。
family: mode (n); mode of transport; sleep mode; payment mode

en: at the present time, compared with the past
simple: Nowadays, most people use smartphones.
simple_zh: 現今大多數人都使用智慧型手機。
toeic: Nowadays, many firms allow employees to work remotely.
toeic_zh: 現今許多公司允許員工遠距工作。

en: very different from usual; extreme
simple: They made a radical change.
toeic: The CEO proposed a radical restructuring of the sales department.
toeic_zh: 執行長提議對業務部門進行徹底重組。

en: official permission or agreement
simple: I need my boss's approval.
toeic: All expense reports require approval from a department manager.
toeic_zh: 所有費用報告都需要部門經理核准。

en: using computer technology and numbers
simple: I bought a digital camera.
toeic: The firm is moving its records into a digital format.
toeic_zh: 公司正把紀錄轉為數位格式。

en: to change to fit a new situation
simple: Children adapt to new schools fast.
simple_zh: 孩子很快就能適應新學校。
toeic: The firm had to adapt its strategy to the changing market.
toeic_zh: 公司必須調整策略以因應不斷變動的市場。

en: to match something; to exchange letters
simple: I correspond with a friend in Japan.
simple_zh: 我和一位日本朋友通信。
toeic: The figures in the report do not correspond to the invoice.
toeic_zh: 報告中的數字與發票不相符。

en: to give time or effort to something
simple: She will dedicate her time to music.
toeic: The firm plans to dedicate more resources to research.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃投入更多資源於研究。
family: dedicated (adj); dedication (n); dedicate A to B

en: to succeed in doing something
simple: I want to accomplish my goal.
toeic: The team managed to accomplish all its targets ahead of schedule.
toeic_zh: 團隊提前完成了所有目標。

en: the way something is arranged or saved
simple: Choose a different format for the file.
simple_zh: 為這個檔案選擇不同的格式。
toeic: Please submit your report in PDF format by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前以 PDF 格式提交報告。

en: exactly as the words say; really
simple: He literally ran all the way.
toeic: The CEO was literally working around the clock during the merger.
toeic_zh: 併購期間，執行長真的是日夜不停地工作。

en: to give someone a job or task
simple: The teacher will assign homework.
toeic: The manager will assign a new project to each team.
toeic_zh: 經理會把新專案分派給各團隊。
family: assignment (n); assigned (adj); assign A to B

en: in a way that happens by itself without a person doing it
simple: The door opens automatically.
toeic: Invoices are sent automatically at the end of each month.
toeic_zh: 發票會在每個月底自動寄出。

en: something that a person owns, or the state of owning it
simple: I keep my possessions in a bag.
simple_zh: 我把我的財物放在袋子裡。
toeic: Please keep your personal possession with you at all times.
toeic_zh: 請隨時將您的個人財物帶在身邊。
family: personal possessions; in possession of; possess (v)

en: demanding that rules be obeyed closely
simple: Our teacher is very strict.
toeic: The company has a strict policy on confidential information.
toeic_zh: 公司對機密資訊有嚴格的規定。

en: a rule or condition that limits something
simple: Time is our main limitation.
simple_zh: 時間是我們主要的限制。
toeic: The software has a limitation on the number of users.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體對使用者人數有所限制。

en: the act of working together to reach a goal
simple: Thank you for your cooperation.
toeic: Close cooperation between departments improved our delivery time.
toeic_zh: 部門之間的密切合作縮短了我們的交貨時間。
family: cooperate (v) with; cooperative (adj); in cooperation with

en: the act of putting a plan or system into use
simple: The implementation took three days.
toeic: The implementation of the new payroll system begins next week.
toeic_zh: 新薪資系統將於下週開始實施。
family: implement (v); implement a plan/policy; smooth implementation

en: to change something to improve it or make it correct
simple: Please revise your essay.
toeic: We need to revise the budget before the final approval.
toeic_zh: 我們需要在最終核准前修訂預算。
family: revision (n); revised edition; revise a plan

en: existing as an idea and not as a real thing; a short summary
simple: Love is an abstract idea.
toeic: The proposal was too abstract to guide daily operations.
toeic_zh: 這份提案太抽象，無法指導日常營運。
family: abstract (n) of a paper; abstraction (n); abstract concept

en: a computer that stores and shares data; a person who serves food
simple: The server is down again today.
toeic: Our IT staff will replace the main server over the weekend.
toeic_zh: 我們的資訊人員將在週末更換主要伺服器。
family: serve (v); service (n); file server; mail server

en: a small broken piece of something
simple: He picked up a fragment of glass.
toeic: The report contained only a fragment of the data we requested.
toeic_zh: 這份報告只包含我們所要求資料的一小部分。

en: a file sent together with an email
simple: I opened the attachment on my phone.
simple_zh: 我在手機上打開了附件。
toeic: Please review the attachment and send your comments by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請查看附件，並在週五前提供你的意見。

en: a senior manager in a company
simple: The executive arrived at the office early.
simple_zh: 那位主管很早就到辦公室了。
toeic: A senior executive will announce the merger at tomorrow's press conference.
toeic_zh: 一位資深高階主管將在明天的記者會上宣布合併案。
family: execute (v); execution (n); chief executive; executive summary

en: the work of managing an organization
simple: She works in the school administration.
simple_zh: 她在學校行政部門工作。
toeic: The administration will announce the new vacation policy next week.
toeic_zh: 管理部門將於下週公布新的休假政策。

en: a set of steps for doing something
simple: Follow the procedure on the sign.
simple_zh: 請依照告示上的步驟操作。
toeic: Staff must follow the safety procedure when using the machines.
toeic_zh: 員工使用機器時必須遵守安全程序。

en: to make certain that something happens
simple: Please ensure the door is locked.
toeic: Managers must ensure that all invoices are approved before payment.
toeic_zh: 經理必須確保所有發票在付款前都經過核准。

en: right or suitable for a situation
simple: Wear appropriate clothes for the rain.
simple_zh: 下雨天要穿適合的衣服。
toeic: Please wear appropriate attire to the client dinner.
toeic_zh: 請穿著合宜的服裝出席客戶晚宴。

en: to give help, money or ideas to something
simple: Everyone can contribute to the party.
simple_zh: 每個人都可以為派對出一份力。
toeic: Several teams contribute to the success of each product launch.
toeic_zh: 數個團隊共同促成每次產品發表的成功。

en: to start using a new idea or method
simple: We adopt a new rule today.
simple_zh: 我們今天採用一項新規定。
toeic: The company decided to adopt a flexible work schedule.
toeic_zh: 公司決定採用彈性工作時程。

en: a particular form of something
simple: I have the newest version of the app.
simple_zh: 我有這個應用程式的最新版本。
toeic: The updated version of the software fixes several security issues.
toeic_zh: 更新版的軟體修復了幾個安全性問題。

en: having many parts and hard to understand
simple: This game is too complex for me.
simple_zh: 這個遊戲對我來說太複雜了。
toeic: The merger involved a complex legal process that took months.
toeic_zh: 這次合併涉及一個耗時數個月的複雜法律程序。

en: most important; main
simple: Our primary goal is to learn.
simple_zh: 我們的主要目標是學習。
toeic: Our primary concern is the safety of every employee.
toeic_zh: 我們最關心的是每位員工的安全。

en: in charge of something, or able to be blamed for it
simple: He is responsible for the team.
toeic: Ms. Lee is responsible for approving all travel requests.
toeic_zh: 李小姐負責核准所有出差申請。

en: a group of things that share similar features
simple: Which category is this book in?
toeic: Expense reports are sorted into one category for each department.
toeic_zh: 費用報告按各部門分入同一類別。

en: a change made to improve a system or law
simple: The country needs tax reform.
simple_zh: 這個國家需要稅制改革。
toeic: The board approved a major reform of the pension plan.
toeic_zh: 董事會核准了退休金制度的重大改革。
family: reform (v); reformer (n); tax reform; reform a policy

en: an idea about how something works or should be done
simple: I like your new concept.
toeic: The marketing team presented a fresh concept for the ad campaign.
toeic_zh: 行銷團隊為廣告活動提出了嶄新的構想。
family: conceptual (adj); conceive (v); concept of; concept design

en: a change that makes something better
simple: I see an improvement in her English.
simple_zh: 我看到她的英文有進步。
toeic: Customers reported a clear improvement in our response time.
toeic_zh: 顧客反映我們的回應速度明顯改善。
family: improve (v); improve on; make an improvement in

en: to make it possible for someone to do something
simple: This tool will enable you to work.
toeic: The new software will enable staff to access files from home.
toeic_zh: 新軟體將使員工能從家裡存取檔案。
family: enabled (adj); able (adj); ability (n); enable A to do

en: used to add another important point
simple: It is cheap; moreover, it is good.
simple_zh: 它很便宜，而且品質很好。
toeic: The plan is affordable; moreover, it can be completed on time.
toeic_zh: 這項計畫負擔得起；此外，也能準時完成。

en: to change a figure so it shows the amount for a full year
simple: We annualize the monthly sales figure.
simple_zh: 我們把月銷售數字換算成年數字。
toeic: Analysts annualize the quarterly profit to forecast total earnings.
toeic_zh: 分析師將季度獲利換算成年率來預測總收益。

en: to admit that something is true, or to give up something
simple: He had to concede the point.
toeic: The union agreed to concede several demands during the wage talks.
toeic_zh: 工會在薪資協商中同意讓步，放棄數項要求。

en: to discuss something with others before deciding, or to give an award
simple: The managers will confer after lunch.
toeic: The directors will confer privately before announcing the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事們將在宣布合併前私下商議。
family: conference (n); confer with sb; confer a degree/title on sb

en: to think carefully about doing something
simple: I contemplate changing my job.
toeic: The board will contemplate several options before choosing a new supplier.
toeic_zh: 董事會將在選定新供應商之前仔細考慮幾個方案。

en: to have or show a link between two things
simple: Sales correlate with the weather.
toeic: Customer satisfaction scores tend to correlate with repeat purchases.
toeic_zh: 顧客滿意度分數往往與回頭購買率相關。
family: correlation (n); correlate with sth; positive correlation

en: to consider something to be a certain way
simple: The judge will deem it a fair price.
simple_zh: 法官會認為這是合理的價格。
toeic: The committee will deem the proposal acceptable if it meets all safety standards.
toeic_zh: 若提案符合所有安全標準，委員會將視為可接受。

en: to be a sign of something, or to mean something
simple: A red light will denote a problem.
toeic: An asterisk will denote items that require manager approval.
toeic_zh: 星號表示需要經理核准的項目。

en: to prepare a plan or idea carefully with all the details
simple: We need to formulate a new plan.
simple_zh: 我們需要擬定一個新計畫。
toeic: The committee will formulate a policy on remote work next month.
toeic_zh: 委員會下個月將擬定遠距工作的政策。

en: until now or until the time being discussed
simple: This is hitherto unknown to us.
simple_zh: 這件事到目前為止我們都不知道。
toeic: The merger created a hitherto unseen level of competition.
toeic_zh: 這次合併創造出迄今未見的競爭程度。

en: to make someone more likely to do something; to slope
simple: Good service will incline people to return.
simple_zh: 良好的服務會讓人願意再次光臨。
toeic: Strong sales figures incline the board to approve the expansion.
toeic_zh: 亮眼的銷售數字使董事會傾向核准擴張案。

en: to appear as a possible danger or problem
simple: Dark clouds loom over the city.
toeic: Budget cuts loom as the quarterly deadline approaches.
toeic_zh: 隨著季末截止日逼近，預算削減的陰影也隨之而來。
family: looming (adj); loom large; a looming deadline

en: in a way that is important enough to matter
simple: The new plan changed things materially.
simple_zh: 新計畫實質上改變了許多事。
toeic: The delay did not materially affect the project's final cost.
toeic_zh: 這次延誤並未對專案的最終成本造成重大影響。

en: a person who discusses terms to reach an agreement
simple: The negotiator helped both sides agree.
simple_zh: 協商代表幫助雙方達成共識。
toeic: Our chief negotiator secured a better price from the overseas supplier.
toeic_zh: 我們的首席談判代表向海外供應商爭取到更好的價格。

en: to be more important or greater than something
simple: The good points outweigh the bad ones.
toeic: The long-term savings outweigh the high cost of installing the new system.
toeic_zh: 長期節省的成本超過安裝新系統的高額費用。

en: to make something last longer
simple: Please do not prolong the meeting.
toeic: Regular maintenance can prolong the life of the machinery.
toeic_zh: 定期維護可以延長機器的使用壽命。

en: to make an agreement official by signing or voting
simple: The members will ratify the new rules.
simple_zh: 成員們將正式批准新規則。
toeic: The board must ratify the contract before it can take effect.
toeic_zh: 合約必須經董事會批准才能生效。

en: to say something again in a clear or different way
simple: Please restate your question.
toeic: Allow me to restate the key points before we vote.
toeic_zh: 在我們表決之前，請容我重述幾個重點。

zh: 懷疑論者；持懷疑態度的人
en: a person who doubts that something is true or will work
simple: My brother is a skeptic about ghosts.
toeic: Even the biggest skeptic admitted the pilot program was a success.
toeic_zh: 就連最大的懷疑者也承認這項試行計畫很成功。

en: to guess about something without knowing all the facts
simple: People speculate about the winner.
toeic: Staff began to speculate about the outcome of the merger talks.
toeic_zh: 員工開始揣測合併談判的結果。

en: to bring different parts together as one
simple: The new leader will unify the country.
simple_zh: 新領導人將會統一這個國家。
toeic: The CEO wants to unify the three divisions under one brand.
toeic_zh: 執行長希望把三個部門整合在同一個品牌之下。

en: able to change to fit new conditions
simple: Young animals are adaptive and learn fast.
simple_zh: 幼小的動物適應力強，學得很快。
toeic: We need an adaptive strategy that responds to market changes.
toeic_zh: 我們需要一個能因應市場變化的彈性策略。

en: a comparison that shows how two things are alike
simple: He used an analogy to explain it.
simple_zh: 他用類比來解釋這件事。
toeic: The manager used a sports analogy to motivate the team.
toeic_zh: 經理用運動來作比喻以激勵團隊。
family: analogous (adj); by analogy; draw an analogy

en: the sound of people clapping to show they like something
simple: The crowd gave loud applause.
toeic: The presenter received warm applause after the product demo.
toeic_zh: 產品示範結束後，主講人獲得熱烈的掌聲。
family: applaud (v); a round of applause; applause for

en: clear, logical and easy to understand
simple: Her story is clear and coherent.
toeic: The manager asked for a coherent plan before the budget meeting.
toeic_zh: 經理要求在預算會議前提出一份條理清楚的計畫。

en: a detailed written or spoken judgment of a piece of work
simple: He wrote a short critique of the film.
simple_zh: 他寫了一篇關於這部電影的短評。
toeic: Please send me your critique of the draft proposal by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前把你對提案草稿的評析寄給我。
family: critique (v); critic (n); critical (adj); a peer critique

en: a signal that tells someone when to do something
simple: Wait for my cue, then speak.
simple_zh: 等我的提示再開口說話。
toeic: The presenter took her cue from the host and began the demonstration.
toeic_zh: 簡報者接到主持人的提示後開始進行示範。
family: take a cue from; on cue; visual cue

en: serious spoken or written discussion of a subject
simple: We had a long discourse today.
simple_zh: 我們今天進行了一場長談。
toeic: Public discourse about the merger has grown more critical this week.
toeic_zh: 本週公眾對這次合併的論述變得更加批判。

en: one part or side of a subject or situation
simple: This is one facet of the job.
simple_zh: 這是這份工作的其中一個面向。
toeic: Each facet of the merger must be reviewed by the legal team.
toeic_zh: 這次合併的每一個層面都必須由法務團隊審查。

en: to turn something over quickly
simple: Flip the page to see more.
toeic: Please flip the chart over to see the quarterly sales figures.
toeic_zh: 請把圖表翻過來查看每季的銷售數字。
family: flip chart; flip a switch; flip-flop (n)

en: a printed paper given to people at a meeting or class
simple: The teacher gave us a handout.
simple_zh: 老師發給我們一份講義。
toeic: Each attendee received a handout summarizing the key points of the meeting.
toeic_zh: 每位與會者都拿到一份摘要會議重點的講義。
family: hand out (v phr); handbook (n); free handout

en: the start of something new
simple: The initiation of the plan is today.
toeic: The initiation of the new policy will begin next Monday.
toeic_zh: 新政策將於下週一開始實施。

en: a word or phrase used to describe something as if it were something else
simple: The poem has a metaphor.
toeic: The CEO used a sports metaphor to describe the merger.
toeic_zh: 執行長用運動比喻來形容這次合併。

en: on the edge; less important
simple: Printers are peripheral devices.
toeic: Peripheral issues should not distract us from the main goal of the meeting.
toeic_zh: 次要議題不該讓我們偏離會議的主要目標。

en: relating to the study of ideas about life and truth
simple: He asked a philosophical question.
toeic: The two founders have a different philosophical approach to risk.
toeic_zh: 兩位創辦人對風險抱持不同的哲學觀點。

en: relating to the meaning of words
simple: It is only a semantic difference.
toeic: The contract dispute turned on a semantic difference in one clause.
toeic_zh: 這起合約糾紛的關鍵在於某一條款的語意差異。

en: the combining of different ideas or parts into one
simple: This book is a synthesis of ideas.
simple_zh: 這本書是各種想法的綜合。
toeic: The report is a synthesis of data from five regional offices.
toeic_zh: 這份報告綜合了五個區域辦公室的數據。

en: relating to time
simple: We face a temporal limit.
simple_zh: 我們面臨時間上的限制。
toeic: The project faces temporal constraints because the launch date is fixed.
toeic_zh: 由於上市日期已定，專案面臨時間上的限制。

en: a person who develops ideas to explain something
simple: The theorist wrote a book.
simple_zh: 那位理論家寫了一本書。
toeic: A leading management theorist will speak at tomorrow's conference.
toeic_zh: 一位知名的管理理論家將在明天的研討會上演講。

en: not important or serious
simple: That is a trivial problem.
toeic: Do not waste the meeting on trivial details that can be handled by email.
toeic_zh: 不要把會議時間浪費在可以用電子郵件處理的瑣碎細節上。

en: about; not exactly
simple: It takes approximately ten minutes.
toeic: The conference will last approximately three hours, including a short break.
toeic_zh: 會議約持續三小時，包括一次短暫休息。

en: to give special attention to something, or to mark text in color
simple: Please highlight the main points.
toeic: The presentation will highlight the key results from the third quarter.
toeic_zh: 這份簡報將強調第三季的主要成果。

en: to describe the main points of something
simple: Let me outline my plan for you.
simple_zh: 讓我向你概述我的計畫。
toeic: The director will outline the new safety procedures at the staff meeting.
toeic_zh: 主任將在員工會議上概述新的安全程序。
family: outline (n); in outline; outline a proposal

en: a large formal meeting of people from one industry, or an accepted custom
simple: The convention starts on Monday.
toeic: Our sales staff will attend the industry convention in Chicago next month.
toeic_zh: 我們的業務人員下個月將參加在芝加哥舉行的產業大會。

en: to leave something and never return, or to stop doing something
simple: They abandon the old car.
toeic: The board decided to abandon the merger after talks failed.
toeic_zh: 談判失敗後，董事會決定放棄這項合併案。

en: extremely important
simple: Sleep is crucial for health.
toeic: Meeting the deadline is crucial to winning the contract.
toeic_zh: 趕上截止日期對贏得合約至關重要。

en: in the same order as the things you just mentioned
simple: Tom and Ann are ten and twelve respectively.
simple_zh: 湯姆和安分別是十歲和十二歲。
toeic: Sales rose by 5 and 8 percent in May and June, respectively.
toeic_zh: 五月和六月的銷售額分別成長了百分之五和百分之八。

en: a list of things to talk about at a meeting
simple: What is on the agenda today?
toeic: Please review the agenda before tomorrow's staff meeting.
toeic_zh: 請在明天的員工會議前先看過議程。
family: on the agenda; set the agenda; hidden agenda

en: almost, or by using the internet instead of meeting in person
simple: The shop is virtually empty today.
simple_zh: 今天這間店幾乎是空的。
toeic: The team met virtually to discuss the quarterly targets.
toeic_zh: 團隊以線上方式開會討論季度目標。

en: a feeling of worry or anger between people
simple: I felt tension in the room.
simple_zh: 我感覺到房裡的緊張氣氛。
toeic: Rising tension between the two departments slowed the project.
toeic_zh: 兩個部門之間日益升高的緊張關係拖慢了專案進度。
family: tense (adj); ease tension; tension between A and B

en: ideas or advice that people give to help with a decision
simple: We want your input on the plan.
simple_zh: 我們想要你對這項計畫的意見。
toeic: The director asked for staff input before finalizing the budget.
toeic_zh: 主任在定案預算前徵求了員工的意見。
family: input (v); output (opp); data input; input from

en: to change something slightly
simple: I need to alter this dress.
toeic: We may alter the schedule if the vendor is late.
toeic_zh: 如果供應商延遲，我們可能會更動時程。
family: alteration (n); alter A to B; alternate (v)

en: at the beginning
simple: Initially, I did not like this job.
simple_zh: 起初，我不喜歡這份工作。
toeic: The project was initially scheduled to finish in March.
toeic_zh: 該專案最初預定在三月完成。

en: extra time; a phone line inside an office
simple: Please call me at extension 12.
toeic: You may request an extension if you cannot meet the deadline.
toeic_zh: 若無法如期完成，您可以申請延期。

en: very unusual or much greater than normal
simple: She is an extraordinary singer.
toeic: An extraordinary meeting was called to discuss the sudden loss.
toeic_zh: 為討論這項突如其來的虧損，召開了臨時會議。

en: to change something to the opposite or undo it
simple: Please reverse the car slowly.
toeic: The board decided to reverse its earlier decision on the layoffs.
toeic_zh: 董事會決定撤銷先前關於裁員的決定。

en: to change something slightly to make it better
simple: I need to adjust my chair.
toeic: Managers must adjust the schedule when staff are absent.
toeic_zh: 員工缺席時，主管必須調整排程。

en: a person or company that pays for an event or program
simple: A bank is the sponsor of the race.
simple_zh: 一家銀行是這場比賽的贊助者。
toeic: The main sponsor will announce its donation at the opening dinner.
toeic_zh: 主要贊助商將在開幕晚宴上宣布其捐款。
family: sponsor (n/v); sponsorship (n); corporate sponsor; sponsor an event

en: the act of taking part in something
simple: Thank you for your involvement.
toeic: The director denied any involvement in the accounting error.
toeic_zh: 主任否認涉入該會計錯誤。
family: involvement (n); involve (v); involved (adj); get involved in

en: a short description of the main points
simple: Please write a short summary.
toeic: The assistant will prepare a summary of the quarterly results.
toeic_zh: 助理將準備一份季度業績摘要。
family: summary (n); summarize (v); executive summary; in summary

en: connected with seeing
simple: Pictures are a good visual aid.
simple_zh: 圖片是很好的視覺輔助。
toeic: Please include a visual aid in your presentation to the board.
toeic_zh: 請在對董事會的簡報中加入視覺輔助。

en: a person or group that competes against you
simple: Our opponent played very well.
toeic: Our main opponent in the bid cut its prices.
toeic_zh: 我們在競標中的主要對手降價了。

en: shared by two or more people
simple: We have a mutual friend.
simple_zh: 我們有一位共同的朋友。
toeic: Both companies reached a mutual agreement to end the contract.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司達成共識，同意終止合約。

en: an agreement in which each side gives up something
simple: Let's make a compromise and share the cake.
simple_zh: 我們各讓一步，一起分蛋糕吧。
toeic: Both sides reached a compromise on the price.
toeic_zh: 雙方就價格達成妥協。

en: a public statement about something
simple: Please listen to the announcement.
toeic: An announcement about the meeting was posted online.
toeic_zh: 一則關於會議的公告已張貼在網路上。

en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
simple: Your participation is important.
toeic: Employee participation in the survey was higher than expected.
toeic_zh: 員工對問卷調查的參與度比預期高。

en: a room used for formal meetings, or an official group of business people
simple: The meeting is in the large chamber.
toeic: The chamber of commerce will host a networking event on Friday.
toeic_zh: 商會將於週五舉辦交流活動。
family: chamber of commerce; council chamber; chamber music

en: during the time that; although (formal British English)
simple: Please be quiet whilst I talk.
toeic: The manager reviewed the report whilst waiting for the client.
toeic_zh: 經理在等客戶的時候審閱了報告。
family: whilst + -ing; whilst vs while; formal British usage

en: the range of things that a project or activity covers
simple: The job has a wide scope.
simple_zh: 這份工作涵蓋的範圍很廣。
toeic: Please clarify the scope of the project before we begin.
toeic_zh: 在我們開始前，請先釐清專案的範圍。
family: scope of work; beyond the scope; scope creep

en: happening once every week
simple: We have a weekly test.
simple_zh: 我們每週都有一次測驗。
toeic: All team leaders must attend the weekly status meeting.
toeic_zh: 所有組長都必須出席每週的進度會議。

en: causing a lot of public disagreement
simple: This is a controversial movie.
simple_zh: 這是一部有爭議的電影。
toeic: The controversial proposal divided the board of directors.
toeic_zh: 這項有爭議的提案使董事會意見分歧。

en: a small change made to improve something
simple: The seat needs one adjustment.
simple_zh: 這個座椅需要一次調整。
toeic: A minor adjustment to the schedule solved the conflict.
toeic_zh: 對時程所做的小幅調整解決了衝突。

en: the act of being present, or the number of people present
simple: Her attendance at school is very good.
toeic: Attendance at the annual meeting is mandatory for all managers.
toeic_zh: 所有經理都必須出席年度會議。

en: the act of putting your name on an official list
simple: Registration starts at nine o'clock.
toeic: Early registration for the conference closes at the end of this week.
toeic_zh: 研討會的提前報名將於本週末截止。
family: register (v); registrar (n); registration fee; online registration

en: a plan or idea suggested for others to consider
simple: He wrote a proposal for the new park.
simple_zh: 他為新公園寫了一份提案。
toeic: The board approved the proposal to open a branch in Osaka.
toeic_zh: 董事會核准了在大阪開設分公司的提案。

en: a group chosen to make decisions for a larger group
simple: The committee meets every Monday.
toeic: The planning committee will review all budget requests on Thursday.
toeic_zh: 規劃委員會將於週四審查所有預算申請。
family: committee member; chair of the committee; steering committee

en: more than half of a group
simple: The majority of students walk to school.
toeic: The majority of board members voted in favor of the merger.
toeic_zh: 大多數董事投票贊成合併。

en: very important; saying what is wrong
simple: Water is critical for plants.
simple_zh: 水對植物來說非常重要。
toeic: It is critical that we finish the audit before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 我們必須在截止日前完成稽核，這點至關重要。

en: the situation or words around something
simple: Read the word in its context.
simple_zh: 把這個字放在上下文中來讀。
toeic: You should explain the figures in the context of last year's results.
toeic_zh: 你應該根據去年的業績來說明這些數字。
family: contextual (adj); in context; out of context

en: to promise to do something or give time and money to it
simple: I commit to a daily walk.
toeic: The directors commit significant funds to research each year.
toeic_zh: 董事們每年都投入大筆資金進行研究。
family: commitment (n); committed (adj); commit to; commit oneself to

en: careful thought before a decision
simple: Thank you for your consideration.
toeic: Your application is under consideration by the hiring committee.
toeic_zh: 您的申請正由聘僱委員會審議中。
family: consider (v); considerate (adj); considerable (adj); take into consideration

en: to end something, or decide after thinking
simple: Let us conclude the meeting now.
toeic: The manager will conclude the session with a short summary.
toeic_zh: 經理將以簡短摘要結束這場會議。
family: conclusion (n); conclusive (adj); to conclude; conclude a deal

en: to go on to do something next
simple: Please proceed to gate five.
toeic: Once the contract is signed, we can proceed with construction.
toeic_zh: 合約一簽署，我們就可以繼續進行施工。
family: procedure (n); proceeds (n); proceed to; proceed with

en: used to show a difference between two things
simple: He likes tea whereas I like coffee.
simple_zh: 他喜歡茶，而我喜歡咖啡。
toeic: Sales rose in Asia, whereas they fell in Europe.
toeic_zh: 亞洲的銷售額上升，而歐洲則下滑。

en: something you plan to achieve
simple: Our objective is to learn English.
toeic: The main objective of the workshop is to improve teamwork.
toeic_zh: 工作坊的主要目標是改善團隊合作。

en: to disagree with a plan and try to stop it
simple: Many people oppose the new road.
toeic: Several board members oppose the proposed merger.
toeic_zh: 幾位董事會成員反對這項合併提案。
family: opposition (n); opposed (adj); opposite (adj); be opposed to

en: a group of people chosen to make decisions for a town or organization
simple: The city council meets on Monday.
toeic: The local council approved the plan for a new community center.
toeic_zh: 地方議會核准了興建新社區中心的計畫。

en: to take part in an activity or event
simple: Many students participate in the club.
simple_zh: 許多學生參加這個社團。
toeic: All employees are invited to participate in the safety workshop.
toeic_zh: 邀請所有員工參加安全工作坊。

en: a particular way of thinking about something
simple: Try to see it from my perspective.
toeic: From a financial perspective, the merger makes good sense.
toeic_zh: 從財務角度來看，這次合併非常合理。
family: from a ... perspective; put things in perspective; perspective client

en: to put your name on an official list
simple: Please register at the front desk.
toeic: Participants must register online before the conference begins on Monday.
toeic_zh: 與會者必須在週一會議開始前於線上報名。
family: registration (n); registrar (n); register for; cash register

en: to be made of different parts
simple: The team will consist of six people.
simple_zh: 這個團隊將由六個人組成。
toeic: The review panel will consist of three senior managers and two outside experts.
toeic_zh: 審查小組將由三位資深經理和兩位外部專家組成。
family: consist of; consist in; consistent (adj); consistency (n)

en: a period of time used for a particular activity
simple: The training session starts at nine.
toeic: The afternoon session will focus on customer data analysis.
toeic_zh: 下午的場次將著重於客戶資料分析。
family: in session; training session; breakout session; question-and-answer session

en: an organized group of people with a shared purpose; a connection
simple: He joined the local sports association.
simple_zh: 他加入了當地的運動協會。
toeic: The trade association will hold its annual convention in Singapore.
toeic_zh: 貿易協會將在新加坡舉辦年度大會。
family: associate (v); associate (n); associated (adj); in association with

en: an idea or belief about something
simple: I like the notion of working from home.
simple_zh: 我喜歡在家工作的想法。
toeic: Many managers reject the notion that long hours mean higher productivity.
toeic_zh: 許多經理不認同工時長就代表生產力高的看法。
family: notional (adj); a notion of; no notion of

en: the final result of an action or event
simple: The outcome of the game was a surprise.
toeic: We are pleased with the outcome of the contract negotiations.
toeic_zh: 我們對合約談判的結果感到滿意。
family: outcome of; positive outcome; expected outcome; outcomes (pl)

en: right or good enough for a purpose
simple: This shirt is not suitable for the rain.
simple_zh: 這件襯衫不適合下雨天穿。
toeic: We need to find a suitable venue for the annual conference.
toeic_zh: 我們需要為年度會議找到合適的場地。

en: a person who takes part in an activity or event
simple: Every participant got a free lunch.
simple_zh: 每位參加者都拿到免費午餐。
toeic: Each participant must register online before the workshop begins.
toeic_zh: 每位與會者都必須在工作坊開始前上網登記。

en: the person in charge of a meeting or a company board
simple: The chairman opened the meeting.
toeic: The chairman will announce the merger at tomorrow's board meeting.
toeic_zh: 董事長將在明天的董事會議上宣布合併案。

en: a talk that shows information to a group
simple: She gave a short presentation in class.
simple_zh: 她在課堂上做了一個簡短的報告。
toeic: The marketing manager will give a presentation on the new campaign.
toeic_zh: 行銷經理將針對新的宣傳活動進行簡報。

en: a picture that shows numbers or information
simple: The chart shows our sales by month.
simple_zh: 這張圖表顯示我們每個月的銷售額。
toeic: Please refer to the chart on page five for the quarterly figures.
toeic_zh: 季度數字請參閱第五頁的圖表。

en: coming before something else in time
simple: I have a prior meeting at nine.
simple_zh: 我九點有個先前就排好的會議。
toeic: Prior approval from the manager is required for all purchases.
toeic_zh: 所有採購都需事先取得經理的核准。

en: to gradually increase or build up over time
simple: Interest will accrue in your account.
simple_zh: 利息會在你的帳戶中累積。
toeic: Interest on the loan continues to accrue until the balance is paid.
toeic_zh: 貸款利息會持續累積，直到餘額付清為止。

en: a person or group that receives money or an advantage
simple: She is the beneficiary of the fund.
simple_zh: 她是這筆基金的受益人。
toeic: The insurance payment will be sent directly to the named beneficiary.
toeic_zh: 保險給付將直接匯給指定的受益人。

en: to give money or gifts to someone to get an unfair advantage
simple: He tried to bribe the officer.
toeic: It is illegal to bribe a public official to win a government contract.
toeic_zh: 賄賂公務員以取得政府合約是違法的。
family: bribery (n); take/offer a bribe; bribe sb into doing sth

en: the purchase of most or all of a company's shares
simple: The buyout was announced today.
toeic: Management arranged a buyout of the struggling retail chain.
toeic_zh: 管理階層安排了對這家陷入困境的零售連鎖店的收購。
family: management buyout; buy out (v); leveraged buyout

en: to act dishonestly to gain an advantage
simple: He did not cheat on the test.
toeic: The accountant was fired for trying to cheat the company out of money.
toeic_zh: 那位會計師因企圖詐騙公司的錢而被解雇。
family: cheater (n); cheat sb out of sth; cheating (n)

en: power and influence over other people
simple: The mayor has a lot of clout.
toeic: The large retailer uses its clout to negotiate lower prices from suppliers.
toeic_zh: 這家大型零售商利用其影響力向供應商爭取較低的價格。
family: political/market clout; have clout with sb; wield clout

en: to publicly say that someone or something is wrong or bad
simple: People denounce the cruel plan.
simple_zh: 人們公開譴責這個殘忍的計畫。
toeic: Union leaders denounce the proposed layoffs as unfair to workers.
toeic_zh: 工會領袖公開譴責擬議的裁員對員工不公平。
family: denunciation (n); denounce sb as sth; publicly denounce

en: to take something away from someone
simple: Do not deprive him of sleep.
toeic: Budget cuts deprive the staff of the training they need.
toeic_zh: 預算削減使員工得不到所需的訓練。
family: deprivation (n); deprive sb of sth; deprived (adj)

en: a person's usual mood or character; the way something is arranged or dealt with
simple: He has a kind disposition.
toeic: The manager's cheerful disposition helps the team stay motivated.
toeic_zh: 經理開朗的性情有助於讓團隊保持幹勁。

en: to make something better or more valuable
simple: Books can enrich your life.
simple_zh: 書本可以豐富你的生活。
toeic: The training program will enrich employees' skills and knowledge.
toeic_zh: 這項培訓計畫將充實員工的技能與知識。

en: to make something necessary as a result
simple: This job will entail some travel.
simple_zh: 這份工作需要出一些差。
toeic: The new position entails managing a team of ten people.
toeic_zh: 這個新職位需要管理一支十人的團隊。

en: belonging naturally to something as part of its basic nature
simple: Gold has intrinsic value.
toeic: Job satisfaction depends on intrinsic rewards as well as salary.
toeic_zh: 工作滿意度取決於內在獎勵，也取決於薪資。

en: a person who has just arrived or joined
simple: She is a newcomer to our team.
simple_zh: 她是我們團隊的新成員。
toeic: Each newcomer receives a guide to company policies during the first week.
toeic_zh: 每位新進人員在第一週都會收到公司政策手冊。

zh: 使熟悉環境；使適應；以…為導向
en: to help someone get used to a new situation
simple: The guide will orient new students today.
simple_zh: 導覽員今天會帶新生熟悉環境。
toeic: The manager will orient new hires to the company's safety procedures.
toeic_zh: 經理會讓新進員工熟悉公司的安全程序。

en: a large amount of money that is paid to someone
simple: The lucky winner got a big payout.
simple_zh: 幸運的得主拿到一大筆獎金。
toeic: The insurer approved a payout of $20,000 for the damaged equipment.
toeic_zh: 保險公司核准為受損設備賠付兩萬美元。
family: pay out (v); payout ratio; insurance payout

en: a person who gets regular money from the state or a company after retiring
simple: The pensioner walks in the park daily.
simple_zh: 這位退休人士每天在公園散步。
toeic: Each pensioner will receive a notice about the revised benefits.
toeic_zh: 每位退休金領取者都會收到有關修訂福利的通知。

en: the use of profits to put money into a business again
simple: Reinvestment helps the small shop grow.
simple_zh: 再投資幫助這家小店成長。
toeic: Dividend reinvestment allows shareholders to buy more stock without extra fees.
toeic_zh: 股利再投資讓股東不需額外手續費即可購買更多股票。

en: a feeling of not wanting to do something
simple: He showed reluctance to speak.
toeic: Staff showed reluctance to adopt the new software at first.
toeic_zh: 員工起初對採用新軟體表現出抗拒。

en: to change how a company or system is organized
simple: The shop will restructure its team.
simple_zh: 這家店將重組它的團隊。
toeic: The company will restructure its sales department next quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司將於下一季重組業務部門。

en: having the job of watching and directing other workers
simple: She has a supervisory job at the shop.
simple_zh: 她在店裡擔任主管職務。
toeic: Candidates should have two years of supervisory experience.
toeic_zh: 應徵者應具備兩年的主管經驗。

en: that you must pay tax on
simple: Is this money taxable?
toeic: Company cars are a taxable benefit for employees.
toeic_zh: 公司配車對員工來說是應課稅的福利。

en: to keep back something that someone expects to get
simple: Please don't withhold the truth.
toeic: Employers must withhold income tax from each paycheck.
toeic_zh: 雇主必須從每張薪資單中扣繳所得稅。

en: to say your ideas or feelings clearly
simple: She can articulate her ideas clearly.
simple_zh: 她能把自己的想法表達得很清楚。
toeic: Candidates must be able to articulate their career goals.
toeic_zh: 應徵者必須能夠清楚說明自己的職涯目標。

en: willing and able to talk and share information
simple: My boss is very communicative.
toeic: We are looking for a communicative person to join the support team.
toeic_zh: 我們正在尋找善於溝通的人加入客服團隊。

en: the subjects and lessons taught in a school or training program
simple: The school changed its curriculum.
toeic: The new training curriculum includes courses on customer service and safety.
toeic_zh: 新的訓練課程包含客戶服務與安全的相關課程。

en: related to growth or the process of developing
simple: It is a developmental stage for children.
toeic: The firm offers developmental training to help new staff grow quickly.
toeic_zh: 公司提供養成訓練，幫助新進員工快速成長。

en: the act of moving something from its usual place
simple: The earthquake caused much displacement.
simple_zh: 地震造成許多人流離失所。
toeic: Automation has led to the displacement of many factory workers.
toeic_zh: 自動化導致許多工廠員工被取代而失業。

en: basic or simple; at the first level
simple: She teaches at an elementary school.
toeic: The workshop covers only elementary skills for new employees.
toeic_zh: 這個工作坊只涵蓋新進員工的基礎技能。

en: the state of being equal in value or meaning
simple: There is no equivalence between them.
toeic: The agency checks the equivalence of foreign degrees before hiring.
toeic_zh: 仲介在錄用前會確認外國學位的等同性。

en: natural and present from birth
simple: She has an innate sense of music.
toeic: A good salesperson often has an innate ability to build trust.
toeic_zh: 優秀的業務員往往具備與生俱來的建立信任的能力。

en: a person who asks questions in an interview
simple: The interviewer smiled at me.
toeic: The interviewer asked about the candidate's experience in project management.
toeic_zh: 面試官詢問了應徵者在專案管理方面的經驗。

en: to help two sides reach an agreement
simple: A friend will mediate our fight.
simple_zh: 一位朋友會調解我們的爭吵。
toeic: The HR director was asked to mediate the dispute between two teams.
toeic_zh: 人資主任受請調解兩個團隊之間的糾紛。

en: ideas about what is right and wrong
simple: Children learn morality from their parents.
simple_zh: 孩子從父母身上學到道德。
toeic: Questions of morality arose when the firm hid the safety data.
toeic_zh: 公司隱瞞安全數據時，便引發了道德爭議。

en: a person who is new to an activity
simple: I am a novice at cooking.
toeic: The training session is designed for novice users of the accounting system.
toeic_zh: 這場訓練課程是為會計系統的新手使用者設計的。

en: relating to a mother or father
simple: I need parental permission.
toeic: The company offers generous parental leave to all full-time staff.
toeic_zh: 公司為所有全職員工提供優渥的育嬰假。

en: a gradual movement toward a goal or a series of steps
simple: Her progression in English is fast.
toeic: The salary progression at the firm depends on annual reviews.
toeic_zh: 公司的薪資晉升取決於年度考核。

en: to turn in a circle; to take turns
simple: The wheel can rotate fast.
toeic: Staff will rotate through all three departments during training.
toeic_zh: 員工在訓練期間將輪調三個部門。

en: the special words used in a particular field
simple: Medical terminology is hard for me.
simple_zh: 醫學術語對我來說很難。
toeic: New staff must learn the legal terminology used in our contracts.
toeic_zh: 新進員工必須學習我們合約中使用的法律術語。

en: a private teacher who helps one student or a small group
simple: My tutor comes on Monday.
toeic: The firm hired a tutor to teach its new staff business English.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請了一位家教來教新進員工商業英文。

en: a university student who is studying for a first degree
simple: My brother is an undergraduate.
toeic: The company offers summer internships to undergraduate students.
toeic_zh: 公司提供暑期實習機會給大學部學生。

en: the standards used to judge or decide something
simple: What are the criteria for entry?
toeic: Applicants must meet all of the selection criteria to be shortlisted.
toeic_zh: 應徵者必須符合所有篩選標準才能進入入圍名單。
family: criterion (sing.); selection criteria; meet the criteria

en: to keep something or someone
simple: I retain all my receipts.
toeic: The firm offers bonuses to retain its most skilled engineers.
toeic_zh: 公司提供獎金以留住最優秀的工程師。

en: a small part of a larger group
simple: Only a minority voted against it.
toeic: A minority of shareholders opposed the proposed acquisition.
toeic_zh: 少數股東反對這項收購提案。

en: special clothes worn by people at the same job or school
simple: He wears a uniform to work.
toeic: All new employees will receive a uniform on their first day.
toeic_zh: 所有新進員工在第一天都會領到一套制服。
family: uniform (adj, same all over); uniformity (n); dress code

en: a person with deep knowledge of one subject
simple: He is a computer specialist.
toeic: We are hiring a tax specialist to join our finance team.
toeic_zh: 我們正在招聘一名稅務專家加入財務團隊。

en: a short description of a person or company
simple: Please update your profile on the website.
simple_zh: 請在網站上更新你的個人檔案。
toeic: The magazine published a profile of the new company president.
toeic_zh: 雜誌刊登了新任公司總裁的專訪簡介。
family: profile (v); company/customer profile; high-profile (adj); low profile

en: the health and happiness of people, or help given to people in need
simple: The boss cares about our welfare.
toeic: The company is committed to employee welfare and safety.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於員工福利與安全。
family: employee welfare; welfare benefits; social welfare

en: to find new people to work for a company
simple: The shop wants to recruit new workers.
simple_zh: 這家店想要招募新員工。
toeic: We plan to recruit ten engineers before the end of the year.
toeic_zh: 我們計劃在年底前招募十名工程師。
family: recruitment (n); recruiter (n); recruit (n, a new member)

en: to judge how good or useful something is
simple: The teacher will evaluate my work.
toeic: Managers evaluate each employee's performance once a year.
toeic_zh: 主管每年評估一次每位員工的績效。

en: a change from one state or system to another
simple: Moving to a new city is a big transition.
simple_zh: 搬到新城市是很大的轉變。
toeic: The transition to the new software will take about two weeks.
toeic_zh: 轉換到新軟體大約需要兩週。

en: a person who gives expert advice
simple: My adviser helps me choose classes.
simple_zh: 我的指導老師幫我選課。
toeic: The firm hired an adviser to review its tax strategy.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請了一位顧問來檢討其稅務策略。

en: covering a large area or including many things
simple: She has extensive experience in sales.
toeic: The candidate has extensive experience in project management.
toeic_zh: 這位應徵者擁有豐富的專案管理經驗。

en: a number that shows a fact about a large group
simple: This statistic surprised the teacher.
simple_zh: 這項統計數字讓老師很驚訝。
toeic: According to one statistic, online orders rose by thirty percent.
toeic_zh: 根據一項統計數據，網路訂單成長了百分之三十。

en: the act of refusing to accept something
simple: There was resistance to the new rule.
simple_zh: 大家對這項新規定有所抗拒。
toeic: Employee resistance slowed the rollout of the new policy.
toeic_zh: 員工的抗拒拖慢了新政策的推行。
family: resistance (n); resist (v); resistant (adj); resistance to change

en: to publicly support an idea or plan
simple: She advocates for clean water.
toeic: The union will advocate higher wages during the negotiations.
toeic_zh: 工會將在協商中主張提高薪資。
family: advocate (v/n); advocacy (n); advocate for; consumer advocate

en: an expert who gives professional advice for a fee
simple: My uncle works as a consultant.
toeic: We hired a consultant to review our marketing strategy.
toeic_zh: 我們聘請了一位顧問來檢討行銷策略。

en: including everything that is needed
simple: This book is comprehensive and clear.
simple_zh: 這本書內容完整又清楚。
toeic: The report provides a comprehensive review of last year's expenses.
toeic_zh: 這份報告全面檢討了去年的支出。

en: to send someone away from a job or a meeting
simple: The teacher will dismiss class at three.
toeic: The board voted to dismiss the director for misconduct.
toeic_zh: 董事會投票決定因不當行為解僱該主管。

en: advice, or a lawyer who gives advice
simple: She gave me good counsel.
toeic: The firm sought legal counsel before signing the merger agreement.
toeic_zh: 公司在簽署合併協議前先諮詢了法律顧問。

en: to make someone want to do something
simple: Good grades motivate students.
toeic: Managers should find ways to motivate their staff.
toeic_zh: 主管應該想辦法激勵員工。

toeic: The personnel department will announce the new vacation policy.
toeic_zh: 人事部門將公布新的休假政策。

en: a part of a legal document or contract

toeic_zh: 合約中包含一項關於提前終止的條款。
family: contract clause; clause in an agreement; termination clause

en: a range of different people, things, or ideas

toeic: The company promotes diversity in its hiring practices.
toeic_zh: 公司在招募上推動多元化。

toeic_zh: 這位主任在公司任職十年後決定辭職。
family: resign from a post; resignation (n); resign as manager

en: a change made to a law or document

simple_zh: 這份文件需要一項修改。

toeic_zh: 法務團隊提出對租賃合約的修訂。
family: amend (v); make an amendment; amendment to a contract

en: the reason or energy that makes someone want to act
simple: She has a lot of motivation.

toeic_zh: 定期的回饋有助於維持員工的工作動力。

en: a strong wish to continue to do something
simple: She showed great determination.
toeic: The team's determination helped them meet the tight deadline.
toeic_zh: 團隊的決心幫助他們趕上緊迫的期限。

en: able to change easily to fit new situations
simple: My schedule is flexible.
toeic: The company offers flexible working hours to all employees.
toeic_zh: 公司提供全體員工彈性上班時間。

toeic_zh: 應徵者必須具備相關的工程資格才能申請。

en: done by choice, not because you must

toeic_zh: 參加培訓課程是自願的，並非強制。

en: a person who applies for a job or is in an election

simple_zh: 每位應徵者回答了五個問題。

toeic_zh: 人資經理將為業務職缺面試三位應徵者。

en: something that is needed or demanded

simple_zh: 這份工作沒有年齡要求。
toeic: Meeting the safety requirement is essential for all new products.
toeic_zh: 符合安全規範對所有新產品而言都至關重要。

en: something you give or do to help a group or goal
simple: Thank you for your contribution.

toeic_zh: 她對這次合併的貢獻在年度晚宴上受到表揚。
family: contribute (v); contributor (n); make a contribution to

en: to pay someone to work for you
simple: The shop will employ two new workers.
simple_zh: 這家店將僱用兩名新員工。

toeic_zh: 公司計劃在十二月前再僱用五十名員工。

en: a prize given for good work
simple: She won an award for her work.
simple_zh: 她的工作為她贏得了一個獎。

toeic_zh: 公司因卓越的客戶服務而獲獎。
family: award (v) 授予; award-winning; win an award

en: a judgment about the quality or value of something
simple: The teacher gave me an assessment.
toeic: The safety assessment showed several areas that need attention.
toeic_zh: 安全評估顯示有幾個地方需要注意。
family: assess (v); assessor (n); risk assessment; performance assessment

en: connected to what is being discussed or done
simple: Is this book relevant to your study?
simple_zh: 這本書和你的研究有關嗎？

toeic_zh: 請在申請中附上所有相關文件。

en: to give someone a job and pay them

simple_zh: 我們想僱用一位新廚師。

toeic_zh: 公司計劃在年底前僱用二十名工程師。

en: advice about what is good or what to do

family: recommend (v); recommended (adj); on the recommendation of

en: to finish a school or university course

family: graduation (n); graduate (n); graduate from; graduate school

en: the state of having a paid job

en: to stop working because of age

en: following official rules or a serious style

simple_zh: 他穿正式西裝去吃晚餐。

toeic_zh: 必須向人資部門提交正式的辭職信。

en: a person or company that pays people to work

toeic_zh: 雇主必須為所有員工提供安全的工作場所。

toeic_zh: 董事會因成本太高而決定否決該提案。

toeic_zh: 員工達成年度銷售目標即可獲得獎勵。

en: money paid to a worker for their work, often by the hour

toeic_zh: 公司調高了所有兼職人員的最低時薪。

family: absent (adj); absentee (n); in the absence of

toeic_zh: 應徵者至少需要三年的工作經驗。

en: to choose someone officially for a job or role

simple_zh: 他們很快會任命一位新老師。

toeic_zh: 董事會投票決定任命李女士為新任主任。

toeic_zh: 我們僱用臨時工來協助旺季工作。

toeic_zh: 符合資格的應徵者將受邀參加第二次面試。

en: the practice of making people follow rules, or the ability to control yourself

simple_zh: 好學生每天都表現出紀律。

toeic_zh: 要趕上每個專案期限需要很強的自律。

toeic_zh: 主管應該鼓勵員工分享想法。

toeic_zh: 許多投資人在經濟衰退期間規避風險。

toeic_zh: 產品上市將與新店開幕同時進行。

toeic_zh: 行動服務與網路服務的整合改變了電信市場。

toeic_zh: 新的簽證規定讓外國人更容易在此工作。

toeic_zh: 與會的每位政策制定者都支持新的能源計畫。

toeic_zh: 該部會計畫在兩年內將郵政服務民營化。

toeic_zh: 投資於培訓的公司長期而言往往會蓬勃發展。

toeic_zh: 音樂節將以一場特別音樂會向一位知名作曲家致敬。

en: small in size, amount or importance

toeic_zh: 旅客應預期本週末機場會嚴重延誤。

en: happening or done often

en: great comfort and expensive things that are not necessary

en: a plan for how much money you can spend

toeic_zh: 未能準時提交報告可能會對我們造成嚴重後果。
