simple: The editor fixed my mistakes.
toeic: The editor asked the writer to submit the final draft by Friday.
toeic_zh: 編輯要求作者星期五前交出定稿。

en: to find where something is, or to put in a place
simple: Can you locate the exit?
toeic: The firm plans to locate its new warehouse near the port.
toeic_zh: 公司打算把新倉庫設在港口附近。
family: location (n); located (adj); be located in/at; relocate (v)

en: relating to your own country or home
simple: I took a domestic flight.
toeic: Domestic sales account for sixty percent of total income.
toeic_zh: 國內銷售額佔總收入的百分之六十。

en: a plan or preparation for something to happen
simple: We made an arrangement for lunch.
toeic: The travel arrangement includes flights and two nights in a hotel.
toeic_zh: 這項旅遊安排包括機票和兩晚的飯店住宿。
family: arrange (v); rearrange (v); make arrangements for; seating arrangement

en: something valuable that a person or company owns
simple: Her house is her biggest asset.
simple_zh: 她的房子是她最大的資產。
toeic: The firm's intellectual property is its most valuable asset.
toeic_zh: 這家公司的智慧財產是其最有價值的資產。
family: fixed assets; current assets; asset management; asset (adj)

en: a sign or movement that gives information
simple: I have no phone signal here.
simple_zh: 我在這裡沒有手機訊號。
toeic: The strong sales figures are a signal that demand is recovering.
toeic_zh: 強勁的銷售數字是需求正在回升的跡象。
family: signal (v); send a signal; warning signal; signal strength

en: money spent on something
simple: Rent is our biggest monthly expense.
simple_zh: 房租是我們每月最大的開銷。
toeic: Submit your travel receipts to be reimbursed for each business expense.
toeic_zh: 請提交差旅收據，以便報銷每一筆商務費用。
family: expensive (adj); expense report; at the expense of; travel expenses

en: showing the usual qualities of a group or kind
simple: It was a typical Monday morning.
simple_zh: 那是個典型的星期一早晨。
toeic: A typical workday for our staff begins at eight thirty.
toeic_zh: 我們員工典型的一個工作天從八點半開始。

en: most important
simple: The principal reason is the high cost.
toeic: Tourism is the principal source of income for the region.
toeic_zh: 旅遊業是該地區的主要收入來源。

en: to say what will happen in the future
simple: No one can predict the weather.
toeic: Analysts predict that fuel prices will rise sharply next quarter.
toeic_zh: 分析師預測燃料價格下一季將大幅上漲。

en: fair and sensible; not too expensive
simple: The price is very reasonable.
toeic: The vendor offered a reasonable discount for bulk orders.
toeic_zh: 供應商為大量訂單提供了合理的折扣。
family: reason (n); reasonably (adv); unreasonable (adj); at a reasonable price

en: to officially accept a plan or request
simple: The boss will approve my holiday.
toeic: The board is expected to approve the annual budget on Friday.
toeic_zh: 董事會預計週五會核准年度預算。
family: approval (n); approved (adj); approve of; pending approval

en: money borrowed from a bank that you must repay
simple: He got a loan to buy a car.
toeic: The bank approved a small business loan with a low interest rate.
toeic_zh: 銀行核准了一筆低利率的小型企業貸款。
family: loan (v); loan officer; student loan; lend (v)

en: a person who puts money into a business to make a profit
simple: The investor bought many shares.
simple_zh: 那位投資人買了很多股票。
toeic: Potential investors were impressed by the firm's quarterly earnings report.
toeic_zh: 潛在投資人對公司的季度盈餘報告印象深刻。
family: invest (v); investment (n); venture investor; institutional investor

en: to get better or return to a normal state; to get back
simple: He needs time to recover.
toeic: The market is expected to recover once consumer confidence returns.
toeic_zh: 一旦消費者信心恢復，市場預計將回溫。
family: recovery (n); recoverable (adj); recover from; economic recovery

en: to say something officially; to report goods or income
simple: Please declare all goods at customs.
simple_zh: 請向海關申報所有物品。
toeic: Travelers must declare any cash above ten thousand dollars at the airport.
toeic_zh: 旅客必須在機場申報超過一萬元的現金。
family: declaration (n); declared (adj); declare bankruptcy; customs declaration

en: to study something carefully to understand it
simple: I analyze my spending every month.
simple_zh: 我每個月都分析自己的花費。
toeic: The team will analyze the survey results before the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 團隊會在下次會議前分析調查結果。

en: the act of coming in, or a record in a list or system
simple: The entry is on the left side.
toeic: Please check each entry in the database for errors.
toeic_zh: 請檢查資料庫中的每一筆登錄是否有誤。

en: a lower price than the normal price
simple: The shop gives a discount on Mondays.
toeic: Customers receive a ten percent discount on bulk orders.
toeic_zh: 客戶大量訂購可享九折優惠。

en: a part of a whole, or the relationship between amounts
simple: A large proportion of students walk to school.
simple_zh: 很大一部分學生走路上學。
toeic: A growing proportion of our revenue comes from online sales.
toeic_zh: 我們的營收中有越來越大的比例來自線上銷售。
family: proportional (adj); in proportion to; a large proportion of

en: by a large or important amount
simple: The weather changed significantly this week.
toeic: Costs have risen significantly since the new tax took effect.
toeic_zh: 自從新稅制生效後，成本已大幅上升。

en: fairly large in amount, size or importance
simple: He spent a considerable amount of time here.
simple_zh: 他在這裡花了相當多的時間。
toeic: The merger will bring considerable savings to both companies.
toeic_zh: 這次合併將為兩家公司帶來可觀的節省。

en: the act of making something smaller or less
simple: There was a reduction in noise at night.
toeic: The company announced a reduction in travel expenses this quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司宣布本季差旅費用將縮減。

en: to arrange for something to be kept for you
simple: I want to reserve a table for two.
toeic: Please reserve a conference room for the client presentation.
toeic_zh: 請為客戶簡報預訂一間會議室。

en: a list that helps you find things, or a number that shows change
simple: Look in the index at the back.
toeic: The consumer price index rose by two percent last month.
toeic_zh: 消費者物價指數上個月上漲了百分之二。

en: to officially make people follow a rule or pay a tax
simple: Parents should not impose strict rules on kids.
simple_zh: 父母不該對孩子強加嚴格的規定。
toeic: The government plans to impose a new tax on foreign goods.
toeic_zh: 政府計畫對進口商品課徵新稅。

en: in addition to what has been said
simple: I like tea, and besides, it is cheap.
simple_zh: 我喜歡茶，而且它很便宜。
toeic: The hotel is close to the airport; besides, it offers free shuttles.
toeic_zh: 這家飯店離機場很近，此外還提供免費接駁車。

en: to produce a result, profit or crop
simple: This farm can yield a lot of rice.
simple_zh: 這座農場能生產大量稻米。
toeic: The new investment should yield a steady return within a year.
toeic_zh: 這項新投資應能在一年內帶來穩定的報酬。
family: yield (n) = return; high yield; crop yield

en: laws that a government makes
simple: The country passed new legislation last year.
simple_zh: 這個國家去年通過了新的法規。
toeic: New legislation requires companies to report their carbon emissions.
toeic_zh: 新的法規要求企業申報其碳排放量。

en: something that can change or be different
simple: Weather is a variable in our trip plans.
simple_zh: 天氣是我們旅行計畫中的變數。
toeic: Fuel price is a major variable in our shipping budget.
toeic_zh: 燃料價格是我們運費預算中的一個主要變數。

en: to try to achieve something over a period of time
simple: She wants to pursue her dream of singing.
toeic: The firm decided to pursue opportunities in Southeast Asia.
toeic_zh: 公司決定在東南亞尋求商機。

en: a public show of art, products or other items
simple: We saw a photo exhibition on Sunday.
simple_zh: 我們星期天去看了攝影展。
toeic: Our company will have a booth at the trade exhibition in May.
toeic_zh: 我們公司將在五月的貿易展設攤位。

en: to explain something by using examples or pictures
simple: The teacher will illustrate the idea with a picture.
simple_zh: 老師會用圖片說明這個概念。
toeic: This graph helps illustrate the growth in online sales.
toeic_zh: 這張圖表有助於說明線上銷售的成長。

en: a flat round device used to store computer data
simple: My computer has a small disk.
simple_zh: 我的電腦有一個小磁碟。
toeic: Back up all the files on the hard disk before the upgrade.
toeic_zh: 升級前請先備份硬碟上的所有檔案。
family: hard disk; disk drive; disk space

en: the greatest amount or level that is possible
simple: The maximum speed here is 50.
simple_zh: 這裡的最高速限是五十。
toeic: The maximum number of participants per session is thirty.
toeic_zh: 每場次的參加人數上限為三十人。
family: maximum (n/adj); maximize (v); maximum capacity; at a maximum of

en: something you accept as true without proof
simple: That is just an assumption, not a fact.
toeic: Our forecast is based on the assumption that demand will stay high.
toeic_zh: 我們的預測是基於需求將維持高檔的假設。
family: assume (v); assumed (adj); on the assumption that; make an assumption

en: most important and forming the base of something
simple: Reading is a fundamental skill.
toeic: The report points to fundamental problems in our supply chain.
toeic_zh: 報告指出我們供應鏈存在根本性的問題。
family: fundamentals (n); fundamentally (adv); fundamental change; fundamental right

en: large in amount or importance
simple: He ate a substantial breakfast.
simple_zh: 他吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。
toeic: The firm reported a substantial increase in quarterly profits.
toeic_zh: 該公司公布季獲利大幅成長。
family: substance (n); substantially (adv); substantial amount; substantial progress

en: to see or show the difference between things
simple: I cannot distinguish the twins.
toeic: The label helps customers distinguish our product from cheaper copies.
toeic_zh: 這個標籤能幫助顧客將我們的產品與較便宜的仿冒品區分開來。
family: distinguish A from B; distinction (n); distinguished (adj); distinctive (adj)

en: money you earn after paying all costs
simple: The shop made a small profit.
simple_zh: 這家店賺了一點小利潤。
toeic: Net profit rose by ten percent in the third quarter.
toeic_zh: 第三季淨利成長了百分之十。
family: profitable (adj); profitability (n); net profit; profit margin

en: money you receive from work or investments
simple: Her income is not high.
toeic: Annual income from overseas sales increased last year.
toeic_zh: 去年海外銷售的年收入增加了。
family: annual income; income tax; disposable income; low-income (adj)

en: to receive money for work you do
simple: He earns money by teaching.
toeic: Sales representatives earn a commission on every contract they close.
toeic_zh: 業務代表每談成一份合約就能賺取佣金。
family: earnings (n); earner (n); earn a living; earn a reputation

en: an arrangement to pay later, or praise for something done
simple: I paid with a credit card.
toeic: We will issue a credit for the damaged goods.
toeic_zh: 我們會為受損的貨品開立折讓。
family: creditor (n); creditworthy (adj); credit card; on credit

en: to make something longer or last longer
simple: Can you extend the deadline?
simple_zh: 你可以延長截止日期嗎？
toeic: The supplier agreed to extend the payment deadline by two weeks.
toeic_zh: 供應商同意將付款期限延長兩週。
family: extension (n); extensive (adj); extend an invitation; extend a contract

en: a number of different types of the same thing
simple: The market sells a variety of fruit.
simple_zh: 市場販售各式各樣的水果。
toeic: The cafeteria offers a variety of healthy meals.
toeic_zh: 自助餐廳提供多樣化的健康餐點。
family: vary (v); various (adj); variation (n); a variety of

en: the chance that something may happen
simple: There is a possibility of rain.
toeic: We cannot rule out the possibility of a delay in shipment.
toeic_zh: 我們無法排除出貨延誤的可能性。
family: possible (adj); possibly (adv); impossible (adj); rule out the possibility

en: the way something moves or points, or guidance
simple: Which direction is the station?
toeic: The new CEO will set the strategic direction of the company.
toeic_zh: 新任執行長將制定公司的策略方向。
family: direct (v/adj); directly (adv); directions (n); in the right direction

en: to tell people something officially
simple: The teacher will announce the results.
toeic: The company will announce its quarterly earnings on Friday.
toeic_zh: 公司將於週五公布季度盈餘。
family: announcement (n); announcer (n); announce a plan; officially announce

en: a basic rule or belief that guides behavior
simple: He lives by one simple principle.
simple_zh: 他遵守一個簡單的原則。
toeic: The policy is based on the principle of equal opportunity.
toeic_zh: 這項政策是以機會均等的原則為基礎。
family: principled (adj); in principle; on principle; guiding principle

en: the amount of money in an account, or a steady state
simple: I lost my balance on the ice.
toeic: Please check your account balance before making a payment.
toeic_zh: 付款前請先確認您的帳戶餘額。
family: balance (v); balanced (adj); unbalanced (adj); balance sheet; work-life balance

en: a work period, or a change in position or direction
simple: He works the night shift.
toeic: Employees on the morning shift must arrive by seven.
toeic_zh: 早班員工必須在七點前到達。
family: shift (v); night shift; shift work; shift in strategy; shift supervisor

en: to say or show that something is true or certain
simple: Please confirm your name.
toeic: Please confirm your hotel reservation by email.
toeic_zh: 請以電子郵件確認您的飯店訂房。
family: confirmation (n); confirmed (adj); confirm a booking; reconfirm (v)

en: against unfair control of a market by one company
simple: Antitrust law protects fair competition.
simple_zh: 反壟斷法保護公平競爭。
toeic: Regulators opened an antitrust investigation into the proposed merger.
toeic_zh: 監管機關針對這項擬議的合併展開反壟斷調查。

en: to make something stronger or more confident
simple: Good news will bolster the market.
toeic: The new advertising campaign should bolster sales in the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 新的廣告活動應能在下一季提振銷售。
family: bolster confidence/sales/morale; bolster A with B

zh: 大型企業集團；綜合企業
en: a very large company made up of many different businesses
simple: The conglomerate owns many small firms.
simple_zh: 這個企業集團擁有許多小公司。
toeic: The conglomerate sold its media division to focus on energy and logistics.
toeic_zh: 這家企業集團出售了媒體部門，專注於能源與物流。

en: to refuse to obey or accept something
simple: They defy the new rule.
toeic: The retailer's strong results defy expectations during the economic slowdown.
toeic_zh: 在經濟放緩期間，這家零售商亮眼的成績出乎預期。

en: to show or describe something in a picture or in words
simple: The picture will depict the old town.
toeic: The brochure should depict our products accurately and honestly.
toeic_zh: 宣傳手冊應該準確而誠實地呈現我們的產品。

en: very bad or disappointing
simple: The weather was dismal all week.
simple_zh: 整個星期天氣都很陰沉。
toeic: Dismal sales figures forced the company to cut its budget.
toeic_zh: 慘淡的銷售數字迫使公司削減預算。

en: to change the shape or meaning of something so it is no longer true
simple: The mirror can distort your face.
simple_zh: 這面鏡子會扭曲你的臉。
toeic: Unfair subsidies can distort competition in the market.
toeic_zh: 不公平的補貼可能扭曲市場競爭。

en: the ability to stretch and return; how much demand changes when price changes
simple: This rope has good elasticity.
toeic: Analysts studied the price elasticity of demand for luxury goods.
toeic_zh: 分析師研究了奢侈品需求的價格彈性。
family: elastic (adj); price elasticity; elasticity of demand

en: to be a clear example of an idea or quality
simple: The statue seems to embody hope.
simple_zh: 這座雕像似乎體現了希望。
toeic: Our new logo is meant to embody the brand's commitment to quality.
toeic_zh: 我們的新標誌旨在體現品牌對品質的承諾。

en: to include a large number or range of things
simple: The tour will encompass five cities.
simple_zh: 這趟旅程涵蓋五座城市。
toeic: Our services encompass everything from design to installation.
toeic_zh: 我們的服務涵蓋從設計到安裝的一切事項。
family: encompassing (adj); encompass a wide range of

en: a person or company that enters a market, contest or group
simple: Every entrant gets a free gift.
simple_zh: 每位參賽者都會得到一份贈品。
toeic: A new entrant in the mobile market is challenging the leaders.
toeic_zh: 行動通訊市場的新進者正在挑戰龍頭業者。
family: enter (v); entrance (n); new entrant; market entrant

zh: 創業的；有企業家精神的
en: having the skills and courage to start and run new businesses
simple: She has an entrepreneurial spirit.
toeic: The firm encourages an entrepreneurial culture among its young staff.
toeic_zh: 這家公司在年輕員工之間鼓勵創業精神的文化。

en: to consider one thing to be the same as another
simple: Do not equate price with quality.
simple_zh: 別把價格和品質畫上等號。
toeic: Many customers equate a higher price with better quality.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客把較高的價格等同於較好的品質。

en: to say that something is bigger or better than it really is
simple: Don't exaggerate the story.
simple_zh: 不要把故事說得太誇張。
toeic: The advertisement tends to exaggerate the benefits of the product.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告往往誇大該產品的好處。

en: to make a broad statement based on only a few cases
simple: It is unfair to generalize.
toeic: We cannot generalize from a survey of only twenty customers.
toeic_zh: 我們不能從只有二十位顧客的調查結果下通則。

en: the process of businesses and cultures spreading around the world
simple: Globalization changed many jobs.
simple_zh: 全球化改變了許多工作。
toeic: Globalization has opened new markets for small manufacturers.
toeic_zh: 全球化為小型製造商開啟了新市場。

en: a mobile phone, or the part of a telephone you hold to your ear
simple: My handset is new.
toeic: The company will launch a new handset at the trade fair.
toeic_zh: 公司將在貿易展上推出一款新手機。

en: to become stronger or to make something stronger
simple: Storms will intensify tonight.
toeic: The firm will intensify its efforts to attract younger customers.
toeic_zh: 公司將加強吸引年輕客戶的努力。

en: to make someone very interested and curious
simple: The story will intrigue young readers.
simple_zh: 這個故事會引起年輕讀者的興趣。
toeic: The unusual proposal might intrigue potential investors.
toeic_zh: 這項不尋常的提案可能會引起潛在投資人的興趣。

en: to make laws or rules less strict
simple: The country wants to liberalize its economy.
simple_zh: 這個國家想讓經濟更自由化。
toeic: The government plans to liberalize import rules for electronic goods.
toeic_zh: 政府計畫放寬電子產品的進口規定。

en: easy to sell because people want it
simple: This new phone is very marketable.
toeic: The designers made the product more marketable by simplifying its packaging.
toeic_zh: 設計師簡化包裝，讓產品更具銷售吸引力。

en: a person whose job is to promote and sell products
simple: My sister is a marketer for a bank.
simple_zh: 我姊姊是銀行的行銷人員。
toeic: A skilled marketer can turn a small brand into a household name.
toeic_zh: 優秀的行銷人員能把小品牌變成家喻戶曉的名字。

en: a person or company that controls all of a market
simple: The monopolist sets the price alone.
simple_zh: 獨占企業自己決定價格。
toeic: As the sole monopolist in the region, the utility faced strict government oversight.
toeic_zh: 作為該地區唯一的獨占業者，這家公用事業公司受到政府嚴格監督。

en: to fall quickly and by a large amount
simple: Prices plunge when stores have big sales.
simple_zh: 商店大特賣時價格會驟降。
toeic: Share prices plunge whenever the company announces weaker earnings.
toeic_zh: 每當公司公布獲利走弱，股價就會暴跌。

en: the ability of a business to make money
simple: The shop is worried about profitability.
simple_zh: 這家店很擔心獲利能力。
toeic: The new pricing strategy improved the profitability of the retail division.
toeic_zh: 新的定價策略提升了零售部門的獲利能力。

en: the act of dividing something into smaller groups or parts
simple: Segmentation puts customers into smaller groups.
simple_zh: 區隔會把顧客分成較小的群體。
toeic: Market segmentation helped the firm target younger customers.
toeic_zh: 市場區隔幫助公司鎖定較年輕的顧客。

zh: 世故老練的人；見多識廣的人
en: a person who has a lot of experience and good taste
simple: My aunt is a sophisticate who loves art.
simple_zh: 我阿姨是個世故又愛藝術的人。
toeic: The luxury brand targets urban sophisticates with money to spend.
toeic_zh: 這個精品品牌鎖定有消費能力的都會時尚人士。

en: the extra benefit when two groups work together
simple: Our team has great synergy.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊有很棒的默契。
toeic: The merger is expected to create synergy between the two firms.
toeic_zh: 這次合併預期會為兩家公司創造協同效應。

en: to think something is worth less than it really is
simple: Don't undervalue your own work.
toeic: Many firms undervalue the power of customer reviews.
toeic_zh: 許多公司低估了顧客評論的影響力。

en: not good or helpful; showing a bad opinion
simple: The weather was unfavorable for our trip.
simple_zh: 天氣不利於我們的旅行。
toeic: Unfavorable online reviews caused a drop in sales.
toeic_zh: 網路上的負評導致銷售下滑。

toeic_zh: 團隊在一週內就構思出一個新的廣告活動。

toeic_zh: 廣告中請避免使用任何帶有負面涵義的字詞。

toeic_zh: 每個產品頁面都需要一個簡短的描述詞，以便顧客在線上搜尋。

toeic_zh: 業務團隊在最後一季創下了驚人的成績。

toeic_zh: 新標誌在我們所有包裝上重複使用葉子圖案。

simple_zh: 我們使用一種新的模式。

toeic_zh: 網路購物為零售業創造了新的典範。

toeic_zh: 此次上市帶動了線上訂單的驚人成長。

simple_zh: 我喜歡她對女王的詮釋。

toeic_zh: 報告對我們品牌的描述公正且準確。

toeic_zh: 我們的客戶主要是亞洲的小型企業。

toeic_zh: 數位行銷如今是競爭的關鍵領域。

simple_zh: 她的工作表現一向穩定。

toeic_zh: 品牌需要在所有廣告管道傳達一致的訊息。

simple_zh: 加薪的前景讓他很開心。

toeic_zh: 兩家大公司主導著全球智慧型手機市場。

toeic_zh: 我們的主要競爭對手已將價格降低百分之十。

simple_zh: 綠色衣服是今年的流行。

toeic_zh: 分析師注意到本季網路銷售呈上升趨勢。

toeic_zh: 保單持有人必須在事故發生後三十天內提交理賠申請表。
