simple_zh: 他在比賽中負責記分卡。
toeic: Each agent is rated on a monthly customer service scorecard.
toeic_zh: 每位客服人員都會在每月的客戶服務績效評分表中被評分。

en: to find out something that was hidden
simple: The police will uncover the truth.
toeic: Surveys help us uncover the real causes of customer complaints.
toeic_zh: 問卷調查有助於我們找出客訴的真正原因。

en: great sadness or trouble
simple: He told me all his woes.
simple_zh: 他把所有煩惱都告訴我。
toeic: Customer woes grew after the system upgrade.
toeic_zh: 系統升級後，顧客的怨言增加了。

en: to state firmly that something is true
simple: I affirm that this is true.
toeic: The agent was quick to affirm that the refund had been processed.
toeic_zh: 客服人員立刻確認退款已處理完成。

en: very strange and unusual
simple: That is a bizarre story.
toeic: The customer made a bizarre request that the staff had never heard before.
toeic_zh: 那位顧客提出了員工從未聽過的怪異要求。

en: in a way that judges carefully; in a very serious or important way
simple: She looked at the idea critically.
simple_zh: 她批判性地看待這個想法。
toeic: Customer feedback is critically important to our product design process.
toeic_zh: 顧客意見對我們的產品設計流程至關重要。

en: to make someone believe something that is not true
simple: Do not deceive your friends.
toeic: The company was fined for trying to deceive customers about its prices.
toeic_zh: 該公司因試圖誤導顧客價格資訊而被罰款。

en: a form of a language used in one area
simple: He speaks a local dialect.
toeic: Our call center staff can speak the regional dialect to help local customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的客服中心人員能說當地方言來協助在地客戶。

en: lower in quality or rank
simple: This phone is inferior to that one.
toeic: Customers returned the goods because the material was inferior.
toeic_zh: 顧客因材質低劣而退回了這批貨品。

en: in a way that is surprising or worth noting
simple: Interestingly, he did not laugh.
toeic: Interestingly, the survey showed that most clients prefer email to phone calls.
toeic_zh: 有趣的是，調查顯示大多數客戶偏好電子郵件勝過電話。

en: how common something is
simple: The prevalence of colds rises in winter.
simple_zh: 感冒的盛行率在冬天會上升。
toeic: The prevalence of complaints about delays rose last month.
toeic_zh: 上個月有關延誤的投訴越來越普遍。

en: responding to events instead of planning ahead
simple: A reactive dog barks at everyone.
simple_zh: 容易激動的狗對每個人吠叫。
toeic: A reactive approach to complaints can harm our reputation.
toeic_zh: 被動處理客訴的做法可能損害我們的聲譽。

en: very silly or unreasonable
simple: That price is ridiculous.
toeic: The customer called the late fee ridiculous and asked for a refund.
toeic_zh: 客戶認為滯納金很離譜，並要求退款。

en: not deep
simple: The river is shallow here.
toeic: The agent gave a shallow answer to the customer's complaint.
toeic_zh: 客服人員對客戶的投訴只給了膚淺的答覆。

en: feeling nervous; not relaxed
simple: I feel tense before tests.
toeic: The call grew tense when the customer demanded a refund.
toeic_zh: 客戶要求退款時，通話氣氛變得緊繃。

en: very; in a very bad way
simple: I am terribly sorry.
toeic: We are terribly sorry for the delay in your order.
toeic_zh: 對於您的訂單延遲，我們深感抱歉。

en: something that you say aloud
simple: Her last utterance was very short.
toeic: The manager's careless utterance during the call upset several clients.
toeic_zh: 經理在電話中不經意的發言惹惱了幾位客戶。

en: to meet or experience something, often unexpectedly
simple: We may encounter heavy traffic.
simple_zh: 我們可能會遇到嚴重塞車。
toeic: Customers sometimes encounter errors when they log in to the new portal.
toeic_zh: 顧客在登入新的入口網站時偶爾會遇到錯誤。

en: a statement that says something is bad or wrong
simple: He did not like her criticism.
toeic: The manager welcomed constructive criticism of the new work schedule.
toeic_zh: 經理歡迎大家對新的工作時程提出建設性的批評。

en: an explanation of what something means, or spoken translation
simple: Her interpretation is very clear.
toeic: Different interpretation of the contract terms led to a long dispute.
toeic_zh: 對合約條款的不同詮釋導致了長期爭議。

en: facts or papers that show something is true
simple: I need proof that you paid.
simple_zh: 我需要你已付款的證明。
toeic: Please attach proof of purchase when you request a refund.
toeic_zh: 申請退款時請附上購買證明。

en: a serious argument or disagreement
simple: They had a dispute about the money.
toeic: The dispute between the supplier and the buyer was settled in court.
toeic_zh: 供應商與買方之間的糾紛已在法院和解。
family: dispute (v); settle/resolve a dispute; labor dispute

en: old, used politely for older people
simple: My elderly neighbor is very kind.
toeic: The clinic offers free checkups to elderly residents.
toeic_zh: 這間診所為年長居民提供免費健檢。

en: the state of being able to do something without difficulty
simple: She passed the test with ease.
toeic: The new software improves the ease of tracking orders.
toeic_zh: 新軟體讓追蹤訂單更加容易。
family: ease (v, to make less severe); easy (adj); easily (adv); with ease

en: to tell someone that something is true so they feel sure
simple: I assure you the food is fresh.
simple_zh: 我向你保證食物很新鮮。
toeic: The manager assured clients that the order would arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 經理向客戶保證訂單會準時送達。
family: assurance (n); assure A of B; rest assured

zh: 保險範圍；新聞報導；涵蓋範圍
en: the amount of protection an insurance plan gives, or the news about an event
simple: The news gave good coverage of the game.
simple_zh: 新聞對那場比賽有很好的報導。
toeic: Our health plan offers full coverage for dental care.
toeic_zh: 我們的健康保險方案完整涵蓋牙科治療。

en: to help someone do something
simple: Can you assist me with this box?
simple_zh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？
toeic: Our staff will gladly assist you with your booking.
toeic_zh: 我們的員工很樂意協助您完成訂位。
family: assistance (n); assistant (n); assist A with B

en: to notice or understand something in a certain way
simple: I perceive a problem with this plan.
simple_zh: 我察覺到這個計畫有問題。
toeic: Many customers perceive our brand as reliable.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客認為我們的品牌值得信賴。
family: perception (n); perceptive (adj); perceive A as B

en: the way you think about or understand something
simple: His perception of the city is positive.
simple_zh: 他對這座城市的看法是正面的。
toeic: A new logo may change the public's perception of the brand.
toeic_zh: 新標誌可能會改變大眾對品牌的看法。

en: all the time; again and again
simple: The phone is constantly ringing.
toeic: Our prices are constantly adjusted to match market demand.
toeic_zh: 我們的價格會不斷調整以配合市場需求。

en: a sign or picture that stands for something
simple: The heart is a symbol of love.
toeic: The dollar symbol appears next to every price on the invoice.
toeic_zh: 發票上每個價格旁都有美元符號。

en: to come from or be caused by something
simple: Many problems stem from poor sleep.
simple_zh: 許多問題都源自睡眠不足。
toeic: Most customer complaints stem from late deliveries.
toeic_zh: 大多數客訴都是因為延遲送貨所引起的。
family: stem from; stem (n); stem the flow

en: to explain the meaning of something or translate speech
simple: She can interpret for the guests.
toeic: Analysts interpret the sales figures differently each quarter.
toeic_zh: 分析師每季對銷售數字的解讀都不同。

en: to ask an expert or a source for advice
simple: You should consult a doctor.
toeic: Please consult the manual before you contact technical support.
toeic_zh: 聯絡技術支援前，請先查閱手冊。

en: the state of belonging to a group or club
simple: I have a gym membership.
toeic: Your membership entitles you to a discount on all services.
toeic_zh: 您的會員資格讓您享有所有服務的折扣。
family: membership (n); member (n); membership fee; renew a membership

en: the state of being seen, known or in contact with something
simple: Too much sun exposure is bad.
toeic: The trade show gave our new brand valuable exposure.
toeic_zh: 這次貿易展讓我們的新品牌獲得寶貴的曝光機會。

en: a usual way of doing something in a place or group
simple: It is a custom to bow here.
simple_zh: 在這裡鞠躬是一種習俗。
toeic: It is the custom in this industry to exchange business cards at first meetings.
toeic_zh: 這個產業的慣例是初次會面時交換名片。

en: done quickly without delay
simple: Thank you for your prompt answer.
toeic: We appreciate your prompt payment of the invoice.
toeic_zh: 感謝您及時支付發票款項。

en: to refuse to accept or give in to something
simple: I cannot resist chocolate cake.
simple_zh: 我無法抗拒巧克力蛋糕。
toeic: Some employees resist change when new software is introduced.
toeic_zh: 導入新軟體時，有些員工會抗拒改變。

en: good enough to be allowed
simple: Is this price acceptable to you?
simple_zh: 這個價格你可以接受嗎？
toeic: Late delivery is not acceptable to our customers.
toeic_zh: 延遲交貨是我們的客戶無法接受的。

en: chosen without a plan or pattern
simple: Pick a random number.
toeic: We selected a random sample of 500 customers for the survey.
toeic_zh: 我們隨機抽取了五百位顧客進行調查。

en: a question asking for information, or an official investigation
simple: I have an inquiry about the price.
toeic: We responded to every customer inquiry within one business day.
toeic_zh: 我們在一個工作天內回覆了每一則客戶詢問。
family: make an inquiry; inquire (v); customer inquiries

en: to cause something to start or happen
simple: Smoke can trigger the alarm.
toeic: The price increase could trigger a drop in customer loyalty.
toeic_zh: 漲價可能引發客戶忠誠度下降。
family: trigger a response/alert; a trigger for; triggered by

en: the state of having many connected parts that are hard to understand
simple: The complexity of the game is high.
simple_zh: 這個遊戲的複雜度很高。
toeic: The complexity of the tax rules requires expert advice.
toeic_zh: 稅法規定十分複雜，需要專家建議。

en: a state of not understanding or of disorder
simple: There was confusion at the door.
toeic: A missing schedule caused confusion among the staff.
toeic_zh: 缺少時間表使員工感到混亂。

en: to buy protection against loss or damage
simple: We insure our car every year.
simple_zh: 我們每年都為車子投保。
toeic: The firm decided to insure all its warehouses against fire and flood.
toeic_zh: 公司決定為所有倉庫投保火災及水災險。

en: an act of asking for something politely
simple: I made a request to my teacher.
simple_zh: 我向老師提出了一個請求。
toeic: Please submit your leave request to the HR department by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前將你的請假申請提交給人資部門。
family: request (v); upon request; request for a quote

en: a set of questions asked to many people
simple: We did a survey in class.
simple_zh: 我們在課堂上做了一項問卷調查。
toeic: The customer satisfaction survey shows high ratings for our support team.
toeic_zh: 顧客滿意度調查顯示我們的支援團隊評價很高。

en: to give one thing and get another
simple: I want to exchange this shirt.
toeic: Customers may exchange the item within thirty days of purchase.
toeic_zh: 顧客可在購買後三十天內更換商品。
family: exchange rate; exchange (n); in exchange for

en: a part of a whole expressed out of one hundred
simple: A high percentage of people like tea.
toeic: A small percentage of the revenue comes from overseas markets.
toeic_zh: 一小部分的營收來自海外市場。

en: a contract that pays you money if something bad happens
simple: Do you have travel insurance?
toeic: Our health insurance covers most medical expenses for employees.
toeic_zh: 我們的健康保險涵蓋員工大部分醫療費用。
family: insure (v); insurer (n); insurance policy; insurance premium

en: to become bigger or make something bigger
simple: The shop wants to expand soon.
toeic: The firm intends to expand its operations into Southeast Asia.
toeic_zh: 公司打算把業務拓展到東南亞。

en: easy to see or understand
simple: The answer is obvious to me.
toeic: It was obvious that the budget could not cover the extra cost.
toeic_zh: 很明顯，預算無法支應額外成本。

en: to become smaller in number or amount
simple: Prices decrease in summer.
toeic: Production costs decrease when we order materials in bulk.
toeic_zh: 大量訂購原料時，生產成本會下降。
family: decrease (n) 減少; decreasing (adj); decrease by 5%

en: to produce or create something
simple: Solar panels generate power.
toeic: The campaign helped generate new leads for the sales team.
toeic_zh: 這項活動幫助業務團隊開發出新的潛在客戶。

en: to say that something is not true, or refuse to give
simple: He will deny the story.
toeic: The manager will deny the request because funds are limited.
toeic_zh: 由於資金有限，經理將拒絕這項請求。

en: relating to a large company
simple: He works at a corporate office.
toeic: The corporate headquarters will be moving to a new location.
toeic_zh: 公司總部將搬到新地點。

en: words that tell what someone or something is like
simple: Give me a short description.
toeic: Please read the job description before you submit your résumé.
toeic_zh: 請在提交履歷前閱讀職務說明。
family: describe (v); descriptive (adj); job description; product description

en: a strong belief that you can do something well
simple: She speaks with confidence.
toeic: Strong results gave investors confidence in the new management.
toeic_zh: 亮眼的業績讓投資人對新管理階層有信心。

en: a mistake
simple: I made an error on the test.
simple_zh: 我在考試中犯了一個錯誤。
toeic: A billing error caused the customer to be charged twice.
toeic_zh: 一個帳單錯誤導致客戶被重複收費。
family: erroneous (adj); human error; error message; margin of error

en: a way of communicating or selling; a TV station
simple: This TV channel shows the news.
simple_zh: 這個電視頻道播放新聞。
toeic: The company is expanding its online sales channel to overseas markets.
toeic_zh: 公司正把線上銷售通路拓展到海外市場。
family: distribution channel; channel (v); through proper channels

en: to try to find out the facts about something
simple: The police will investigate the crime.
toeic: The committee will investigate complaints about the new billing system.
toeic_zh: 委員會將調查有關新帳單系統的投訴。

en: to give all your attention to one thing
simple: I cannot concentrate with this noise.
simple_zh: 這個噪音讓我無法專心。
toeic: The firm decided to concentrate its efforts on the Asian market.
toeic_zh: 公司決定把心力集中在亞洲市場。

en: the act of keeping something safe from harm
simple: Wear a hat for sun protection.
toeic: The new policy offers better protection for customer data.
toeic_zh: 新政策為客戶資料提供更好的保護。

en: to promise that something will happen or be true
simple: We guarantee fast delivery.
toeic: The manufacturer will guarantee the product against defects for two years.
toeic_zh: 製造商將對產品瑕疵提供兩年保固。

en: to depend on someone or something
simple: You can rely on me.
toeic: Many small shops rely on holiday sales to cover annual costs.
toeic_zh: 許多小商店仰賴假期的銷售來支應全年開銷。

en: being the only one of its kind
simple: Her voice is truly unique.
toeic: Our product offers a unique feature that no competitor can match.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品有一項競爭對手無法匹敵的獨特功能。

en: useful and sensible in real situations
simple: This is a practical bag for work.
simple_zh: 這是一個很實用的工作包。
toeic: The consultant gave us practical advice for cutting operating costs.
toeic_zh: 顧問給了我們降低營運成本的實用建議。

en: words that make something clear
simple: Thank you for your clear explanation.
toeic: The customer demanded an explanation for the unexpected delay in shipping.
toeic_zh: 客戶要求對出貨意外延遲提出說明。
family: explain (v); explanatory (adj); explicable (adj); give an explanation

en: the highest or busiest point of something
simple: Traffic is bad at the peak of the day.
simple_zh: 一天中的尖峰時段交通很糟。
toeic: Sales reached a peak in December before falling in January.
toeic_zh: 銷售額在十二月達到高峰，一月便下滑。
family: peak season; peak hours; at its peak

en: a statement that says you are not happy with something
simple: She made a complaint about the cold food.
simple_zh: 她針對冷掉的食物提出抱怨。
toeic: The manager promised to look into every customer complaint.
toeic_zh: 經理承諾會調查每一件客戶投訴。

en: to put a plan or decision into action
simple: The school will implement a new rule soon.
simple_zh: 學校很快會實施新規定。
toeic: We plan to implement the new payroll system in January.
toeic_zh: 我們計畫在一月實施新的薪資系統。

en: to tell someone what you think they should do
simple: My doctor will advise me about food.
simple_zh: 我的醫生會就飲食給我建議。
toeic: The lawyer will advise us on how to handle the dispute.
toeic_zh: 律師將就如何處理這項爭議給我們建議。
family: advice (n); advisor (n); advise A to do

en: to accept that something is true, or to say you received it
simple: He did not acknowledge his mistake.
simple_zh: 他沒有承認自己的錯誤。
toeic: Please acknowledge receipt of this message by replying today.
toeic_zh: 請於今天回覆，確認已收到此訊息。

en: to find an answer to a problem
simple: We can resolve this problem quickly.
simple_zh: 我們可以很快解決這個問題。
toeic: The support team worked overtime to resolve the billing issue.
toeic_zh: 客服團隊加班解決了帳單問題。

en: something that is more important than other things
simple: Safety is our first priority.
simple_zh: 安全是我們的首要之務。
toeic: Meeting the customer's deadline is our top priority this week.
toeic_zh: 達成客戶的截止期限是我們本週的首要任務。

en: a formal decision, or the solving of a problem
simple: My resolution is to sleep earlier this year.
simple_zh: 我今年的決心是要早點睡。
toeic: The committee passed a resolution to approve the new budget.
toeic_zh: 委員會通過了批准新預算的決議。
family: resolve (v); resolution of a dispute; pass a resolution

en: relating to a particular area of a country or the world
simple: There is a regional market every weekend.
simple_zh: 每個週末都有地區市集。
toeic: The regional manager visits each branch office once a month.
toeic_zh: 區域經理每月拜訪每間分公司一次。

en: happening right away, without delay
simple: I need an immediate answer, please.
toeic: The client expects an immediate response to his urgent request.
toeic_zh: 客戶期待對他的緊急要求得到立即回應。

en: the most important or central part of something
simple: The core of the apple is hard.
toeic: Customer satisfaction is the core of our business strategy.
toeic_zh: 客戶滿意度是我們經營策略的核心。
family: core (adj/n); core business; core values; core competency

en: the way people or things communicate or affect each other
simple: The children enjoy interaction with animals.
simple_zh: 孩子們喜歡和動物互動。
toeic: Regular interaction between departments improves teamwork.
toeic_zh: 部門之間定期的互動能改善團隊合作。
family: interact (v); interactive (adj); social interaction; interact with

en: worth a lot of money or very useful
simple: Please keep your valuable things safe.
simple_zh: 請妥善保管你的貴重物品。
toeic: Her valuable feedback helped us redesign the product.
toeic_zh: 她寶貴的意見幫助我們重新設計產品。

en: to say that something is good or should be done
simple: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
simple_zh: 你能推薦一家好餐廳嗎？
toeic: I recommend that we postpone the launch until next quarter.
toeic_zh: 我建議我們將上市延到下一季。
family: recommendation (n); highly recommended; recommend that + V

en: working well and producing the result you want
simple: This medicine is very effective.
toeic: The new policy becomes effective on the first of January.
toeic_zh: 新政策於一月一日起生效。

en: to tell someone about something
simple: Please inform me when he arrives.
toeic: Please inform the department head of any schedule changes.
toeic_zh: 請將任何時程變動通知部門主管。
family: information (n); informed (adj); informative (adj); keep someone informed

en: to show or be a sign of something, or to think carefully
simple: The lake can reflect the moon.
toeic: The final price should reflect the cost of materials.
toeic_zh: 最終價格應該反映材料成本。
family: reflection (n); reflective (adj); reflect on; reflect changes

en: a year, used in the phrase 'per annum'
simple: The fee is ten dollars per annum.
toeic: The loan carries an interest rate of five percent per annum.
toeic_zh: 這筆貸款的年利率為百分之五。
family: per annum (= each year); annual (adj); annually (adv)

en: a person or organization that owns bonds
simple: The bondholder receives regular interest.
simple_zh: 債券持有人定期收到利息。
toeic: Each bondholder will be paid in full before the end of the fiscal year.
toeic_zh: 每位債券持有人都將在會計年度結束前獲得全額償付。

en: the total value of a company's shares, or the act of providing it with capital
simple: The firm's capitalization is very large.
simple_zh: 這家公司的市值非常大。
toeic: The market capitalization of the company exceeded two billion dollars last year.
toeic_zh: 該公司去年的市值超過二十億美元。

en: a fall in the value of a currency or an asset
simple: The devaluation worried many traders.
simple_zh: 貶值讓許多交易員很擔心。
toeic: A sudden devaluation of the currency raised the cost of imported materials.
toeic_zh: 貨幣突然貶值使進口原料的成本上升。

en: to make a liquid weaker by adding water; to reduce the strength of something
simple: Please dilute the juice with water.
toeic: Issuing new shares will dilute the value of existing stock.
toeic_zh: 發行新股將稀釋現有股票的價值。
family: dilution (n); dilute A with B; dilute shares

en: to become smaller or to make something smaller
simple: The noise will diminish after midnight.
toeic: Rising costs may diminish our profit margin this year.
toeic_zh: 成本上升可能會壓縮我們今年的利潤率。

zh: 可自由支配的；酌情決定的
en: left to your own judgment; not fixed by rules
simple: I have discretionary time on Sunday.
simple_zh: 我星期天有可自由安排的時間。
toeic: Managers may use discretionary funds for small team events.
toeic_zh: 主管可以動用可自由支配的經費辦理小型團隊活動。

en: to add variety; to spread business or investment across different areas
simple: The shop will diversify its products.
simple_zh: 這家店將讓商品更多元。
toeic: To reduce risk, the firm plans to diversify its investment portfolio.
toeic_zh: 為了降低風險，這家公司計畫分散其投資組合。

zh: 可強制執行的；具法律效力的
en: able to be made to obey by law
simple: This rule is not enforceable.
simple_zh: 這條規定無法強制執行。
toeic: The contract is legally enforceable in both countries.
toeic_zh: 這份合約在兩國都具有法律上的強制執行力。

en: to slowly wear away or reduce something
simple: Rain can erode the soil.
toeic: Rising wages could erode the company's profit over time.
toeic_zh: 薪資上漲可能逐漸侵蝕公司的獲利。

en: a rough judgment of the amount or value of something
simple: My estimation is about ten dollars.
simple_zh: 我的估計大約是十美元。
toeic: In our estimation, the project will finish two weeks early.
toeic_zh: 依我們的估計，這個專案將提前兩週完成。

en: the feeling or belief that something will happen
simple: There is a sense of expectancy today.
simple_zh: 今天有一股期待的氣氛。
toeic: Life expectancy has risen, so pension plans must be reviewed.
toeic_zh: 預期壽命提高了，因此退休金計畫必須重新檢討。

en: a side effect of an activity that affects others who did not choose it
simple: Pollution is an externality of factories.
simple_zh: 污染是工廠的外部效應。
toeic: Environmental harm is a negative externality that the firm does not pay for.
toeic_zh: 環境損害是公司不需負擔成本的負面外部性。

en: the act of selling shares in a company to the public for the first time
simple: The flotation was a big success.
toeic: The flotation of the company is scheduled for next spring.
toeic_zh: 這家公司的股票上市排定在明年春天。
family: float (v); stock market flotation; flotation date

en: a frequent change in amount, price or level
simple: There is a daily fluctuation in prices.
toeic: Currency fluctuation can affect the profit of exporters.
toeic_zh: 匯率波動可能影響出口商的獲利。
family: fluctuate (v); price/currency fluctuation; fluctuations in demand

en: a person whose job is to say what will probably happen in the future
simple: The weather forecaster says it will rain.
toeic: A financial forecaster predicted slower growth in the next quarter.
toeic_zh: 一位財務預測分析師預測下一季成長將趨緩。

en: to worry about small or unimportant things
simple: Don't fret about the small things.
toeic: Investors continue to fret over the slowing economy.
toeic_zh: 投資人持續為經濟放緩感到憂慮。

en: dark or sad; without much hope
simple: It is a gloomy day.
toeic: Analysts remain gloomy about the retail sector this winter.
toeic_zh: 分析師對今年冬天的零售業仍感悲觀。

en: a situation in which things are not equal or fair
simple: There is an imbalance in the team.
simple_zh: 這個團隊有失衡的情況。
toeic: A trade imbalance can hurt the economy of a small country.
toeic_zh: 貿易失衡可能傷害小國的經濟。

en: the legal process of forming a company; the act of including something
simple: The incorporation of the firm was in 1998.
simple_zh: 這家公司成立於一九九八年。
toeic: Articles of incorporation must be filed with the state office.
toeic_zh: 公司章程必須向州政府機關備案。

zh: 通貨膨脹的；引起通膨的
en: causing or related to a general rise in prices
simple: Higher costs are inflationary.
simple_zh: 成本上升會導致通貨膨脹。
toeic: The bank warned of inflationary pressure caused by rising wages.
toeic_zh: 銀行警告薪資上漲將帶來通膨壓力。

en: the movement of money, people or goods into a place
simple: We saw a large inflow of cash.
simple_zh: 我們看到大量現金流入。
toeic: A steady inflow of capital helped the start-up expand.
toeic_zh: 穩定的資金流入幫助這家新創公司擴張。

en: not physical; not easy to touch or measure
simple: Trust is an intangible thing.
toeic: Brand reputation is an intangible asset that adds value to the firm.
toeic_zh: 品牌聲譽是替公司增值的無形資產。

en: the act of officially giving out or publishing something
simple: The issuance of tickets starts today.
toeic: The issuance of new bonds is expected to raise fifty million dollars.
toeic_zh: 新債券的發行預計將籌得五千萬美元。

en: a company or bank that officially provides cards, shares or bonds
simple: The issuer is a big bank.
simple_zh: 發行機構是一家大銀行。
toeic: Contact your card issuer immediately if your credit card is stolen.
toeic_zh: 若信用卡遭竊，請立即聯絡您的發卡機構。

en: to hide the illegal source of money by moving it through businesses; to wash clothes
simple: Criminals launder money through shops.
toeic: The bank was fined for failing to detect attempts to launder money.
toeic_zh: 這家銀行因未能察覺洗錢企圖而被罰款。

en: the act of making rules or laws less strict
simple: Trade liberalization helps many small shops.
simple_zh: 貿易自由化幫助許多小商店。
toeic: Market liberalization has opened the telecom sector to foreign investors.
toeic_zh: 市場自由化已讓電信業向外國投資人開放。

en: the closing of a company and the sale of its assets to pay debts
simple: The shop closed after the liquidation.
simple_zh: 清算之後這家店就關了。
toeic: The company entered liquidation after failing to repay its creditors.
toeic_zh: 該公司因無法償還債權人而進入清算程序。

en: relating to a whole national or world economy
simple: Macroeconomic news is on TV today.
simple_zh: 今天電視上有總體經濟新聞。
toeic: Weak macroeconomic conditions forced the firm to delay its expansion.
toeic_zh: 疲弱的總體經濟情勢迫使該公司延後擴張。

en: a number or factor that makes a result bigger
simple: Use this multiplier to find the total.
toeic: Tourism acts as a multiplier for the local economy by creating jobs.
toeic_zh: 觀光業創造就業機會，對地方經濟產生倍增效果。

en: the movement of money or people out of a place
simple: There was an outflow of water.
toeic: A sharp outflow of capital worried the country's central bank.
toeic_zh: 資金大量外流讓該國央行憂心忡忡。

en: to talk about something as bigger or more important than it is
simple: Please do not overstate the problem.
toeic: It would be hard to overstate the importance of accurate financial reports.
toeic_zh: 準確的財務報告再怎麼強調其重要性也不為過。

en: a state of being equal, especially in pay or value
simple: They want parity in pay for everyone.
simple_zh: 他們希望每個人薪資平等。
toeic: The two currencies reached parity for the first time this year.
toeic_zh: 這兩種貨幣今年首次達到平價。
family: pay parity; parity with (+ noun); disparity (n)

zh: 固定（匯率或價格）；使連動
en: to fix a price or rate at a certain level
simple: They peg the price to the dollar.
simple_zh: 他們把價格與美元連動。
toeic: The country decided to peg its currency to the euro to ensure stability.
toeic_zh: 該國決定將貨幣與歐元掛鉤以確保穩定。
family: pegged (adj); peg A to B; currency peg (n)

zh: 公開說明書；招股說明書
en: a document that gives details about a company or school to attract people
simple: I read the school's prospectus last night.
simple_zh: 我昨晚讀了學校的簡介。
toeic: Investors should read the prospectus carefully before buying any shares.
toeic_zh: 投資人在購買任何股票之前，應仔細閱讀公開說明書。

en: to replace a loan with a new one with better terms
simple: They want to refinance their house loan.
simple_zh: 他們想把房貸重新融資。
toeic: The company chose to refinance its debt after interest rates dropped.
toeic_zh: 利率下降後，該公司選擇將債務再融資。

en: to buy back something that you sold before
simple: I want to repurchase my old phone.
simple_zh: 我想把我的舊手機買回來。
toeic: The company plans to repurchase ten percent of its outstanding shares.
toeic_zh: 該公司計畫回購百分之十的流通在外股份。

zh: 重新估價；重估；（貨幣）升值
en: a new judgment of how much something is worth
simple: The house needs a revaluation.
simple_zh: 這棟房子需要重新估價。
toeic: A revaluation of the firm's assets raised its net worth.
toeic_zh: 公司資產的重新估價提高了其淨值。
family: revalue (v); revaluation of assets; currency revaluation

en: a sudden fall in prices, sales, or activity
simple: Sales had a big slump this year.
toeic: The retailer struggled to recover from a long sales slump.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商難以從長期的銷售低迷中恢復。

en: a person who buys and sells to make a quick profit
simple: The speculator bought many cheap shares.
simple_zh: 那位投機客買了很多便宜的股票。
toeic: A currency speculator can lose money quickly when rates change.
toeic_zh: 匯率變動時，外匯投機客可能很快就賠錢。

en: the place or system where company shares are bought and sold
simple: He watches the stockmarket every morning.
toeic: The stockmarket rallied after the central bank's announcement.
toeic_zh: 央行發布公告後，股市反彈上揚。
family: stock market crash; stock exchange; stock (n)

zh: 次級的；（貸款）信用不佳的
en: given to borrowers who have a poor credit record
simple: Subprime loans are risky for banks.
simple_zh: 次級貸款對銀行來說風險很高。
toeic: Banks tightened lending after the subprime mortgage crisis.
toeic_zh: 次級房貸危機後，銀行收緊了放款。

en: a wrongful act that harms someone and can lead to a lawsuit
simple: Hurting someone by accident can be a tort.
simple_zh: 不小心傷害他人可能構成侵權行為。
toeic: The lawsuit alleges a tort of negligence against the manufacturer.
toeic_zh: 該訴訟指控製造商犯有過失侵權行為。

zh: 分期款項；一批（資金或證券）
en: one part of a sum of money or group of shares released in stages
simple: We got the first tranche of money.
simple_zh: 我們拿到了第一期款項。
toeic: The bank released the second tranche of the loan on Monday.
toeic_zh: 銀行在週一撥付了貸款的第二期款項。

en: to agree to pay for the risk or cost of something
simple: The bank will underwrite our home loan.
simple_zh: 銀行會為我們的房貸提供保證。
toeic: Several insurers agreed to underwrite the shipping risk.
toeic_zh: 幾家保險公司同意承保這項運送風險。

en: a person or company that accepts the risk of insurance or a share sale
simple: The underwriter checked my insurance form.
simple_zh: 保險核保人檢查了我的保險表格。
toeic: The underwriter approved the policy after reviewing the applicant's records.
toeic_zh: 核保人在審閱申請人的紀錄後核准了這份保單。

en: not protected by property that a lender can take
simple: He took an unsecured loan.
simple_zh: 他辦了一筆無擔保貸款。
toeic: Unsecured creditors may receive only a fraction of what they are owed.
toeic_zh: 無擔保債權人可能只能拿回應得款項的一小部分。

en: to become or make something less strong
simple: Bad food can weaken your body.
simple_zh: 不好的食物會讓你的身體變虛弱。
toeic: A strong dollar could weaken demand for our exports.
toeic_zh: 強勢美元可能削弱對我們出口產品的需求。

en: a spoken or written set of opinions about an event or topic
simple: I like the radio commentary.
simple_zh: 我喜歡這個廣播實況解說。
toeic: The financial commentary in the annual report explains the drop in profits.
toeic_zh: 年度報告中的財務評論解釋了獲利下滑的原因。

en: having parts that disagree with each other
simple: The two reports are contradictory.
toeic: The auditor found contradictory figures in the two financial statements.
toeic_zh: 稽核員發現兩份財務報表中的數字互相矛盾。

en: to change information into a code
simple: They encode the message first.
toeic: The software will encode customer data before it is sent to the bank.
toeic_zh: 軟體會在客戶資料傳送到銀行之前先將其加密。

en: growing faster and faster
simple: The growth was exponential last year.
simple_zh: 去年的成長是爆發性的。
toeic: The startup achieved exponential growth in customers during its first year.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司在第一年就達成客戶數的爆發性成長。

en: having an end or limit
simple: Time is finite for everyone.
simple_zh: 每個人的時間都是有限的。
toeic: The department has a finite budget, so spending must be carefully planned.
toeic_zh: 部門的預算有限，因此支出必須仔細規劃。

en: a note at the bottom of a page
simple: Read the footnote at the bottom.
toeic: See the footnote on page five for details about the tax rate.
toeic_zh: 關於稅率的詳細資訊請見第五頁的註腳。

en: something that seems real but is not
simple: The mirror creates an illusion.
toeic: Investors should not be under the illusion that profits will come quickly.
toeic_zh: 投資人不應抱有獲利很快就會到來的幻想。
family: illusory (adj); optical illusion; under the illusion that

en: having strong moral qualities; from a high social class
simple: He has a noble heart.
toeic: The foundation pursues the noble goal of funding rural schools.
toeic_zh: 該基金會追求資助偏鄉學校的崇高目標。

en: the beginning of something, often something unpleasant
simple: Rain came at the onset of winter.
toeic: Sales dropped sharply at the onset of the recession.
toeic_zh: 經濟衰退一開始，銷售額就大幅下滑。
family: at the onset of; sudden onset

en: a situation with two opposite facts that seems strange
simple: It is a strange paradox.
toeic: It is a paradox that higher prices led to more sales.
toeic_zh: 價格提高反而帶來更多銷量，這是個矛盾。

en: dealing with things in a practical and sensible way
simple: She is a pragmatic person.
toeic: We need a pragmatic solution that fits our limited budget.
toeic_zh: 我們需要一個符合有限預算的務實方案。

en: very great or deep
simple: It had a profound effect on me.
toeic: The new tax law will have a profound impact on small firms.
toeic_zh: 新稅法將對小型企業產生深遠的影響。

en: the quality of being sensible and logical
simple: He acts with rationality.
toeic: Investors should show rationality when the market falls.
toeic_zh: 市場下跌時，投資人應該保持理性。

en: representing an idea; having a deeper meaning
simple: A white dove is symbolic of peace.
toeic: The CEO made a symbolic gesture by taking a pay cut.
toeic_zh: 執行長以減薪作為象徵性的姿態。

en: likely to change or fail suddenly
simple: The table is unstable and shaky.
toeic: Unstable exchange rates made it difficult to price our export goods.
toeic_zh: 匯率不穩使我們難以為出口商品定價。

en: a large company or group of companies
simple: He works for a large corporation.
toeic: The corporation announced plans to open three new branches overseas.
toeic_zh: 該企業宣布計劃在海外開設三間新分公司。

en: to find a number or amount by using mathematics
simple: Can you calculate the total cost?
toeic: The accountant will calculate each employee's overtime pay at month end.
toeic_zh: 會計將在月底計算每位員工的加班費。

en: as much as is needed
simple: We have sufficient food for everyone.
simple_zh: 我們有足夠的食物給大家。
toeic: The budget must be sufficient to cover all travel and training costs.
toeic_zh: 預算必須足以涵蓋所有差旅與訓練費用。

en: to divide into parts or share between people
simple: Let us split the bill.
toeic: The partners agreed to split the profits equally after paying all expenses.
toeic_zh: 合夥人同意在付清所有開支後平分利潤。
family: split (n); split up; split the cost

en: mainly; most importantly
simple: He works primarily at night.
toeic: Our revenue comes primarily from subscription fees rather than one-time sales.
toeic_zh: 我們的收入主要來自訂閱費，而非一次性銷售。

en: a careful look at something, or a formal test
simple: The doctor did an examination.
toeic: A thorough examination of the accounts revealed several errors.
toeic_zh: 對帳目的徹底檢查發現了幾處錯誤。

en: to get something from a source
simple: Many words derive from Latin.
toeic: The firm derives most of its income from overseas contracts.
toeic_zh: 這家公司的大部分收入來自海外合約。

en: the state of having no job, or the number of people without jobs
simple: Unemployment is high this year.
toeic: The rise in unemployment has reduced consumer spending in the region.
toeic_zh: 失業率上升降低了該地區的消費支出。

en: money paid regularly to a person who has retired
simple: He receives a small pension.
toeic: Employees can contribute to the company pension plan from their first month.
toeic_zh: 員工從入職第一個月起就可以提撥公司的退休金計畫。

en: the act of buying a company or getting something new
simple: The acquisition of the shop made him happy.
simple_zh: 收購那間店讓他很開心。
toeic: The acquisition of Delta Foods will be finalized next month.
toeic_zh: 對德爾塔食品公司的收購將於下個月完成。
family: acquire (v); acquisition of A; a hostile acquisition

en: in the end, after everything else has happened
simple: Ultimately, we chose the blue car.
simple_zh: 最後，我們選了藍色的車。
toeic: The board will ultimately decide whether to approve the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事會最終將決定是否批准這項合併。

en: a business or company, often a new or large one
simple: He started a small enterprise last year.
simple_zh: 他去年創辦了一家小企業。
toeic: The enterprise plans to expand into three new markets.
toeic_zh: 這家企業計劃拓展到三個新市場。

en: to have to pay money back to someone
simple: I owe my friend ten dollars.
toeic: Customers who owe more than $500 will receive a reminder letter.
toeic_zh: 欠款超過五百美元的客戶將收到催繳通知。
family: owing to (prep); owed (adj); owe A to B

en: a person who is the official head of a state or an organization
simple: The governor visited our city today.
simple_zh: 州長今天來訪我們的城市。
toeic: The governor announced new tax incentives for local manufacturers.
toeic_zh: 州長宣布了給本地製造商的新稅務優惠。

en: continuing in a regular way without sudden changes
simple: He has a steady job.
toeic: The firm reported steady growth in the third quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司回報第三季穩定成長。

en: to show that a decision or action is reasonable
simple: Can you justify this high price?
simple_zh: 你能說明這個高價的合理性嗎？
toeic: You must justify every expense in the budget proposal.
toeic_zh: 你必須為預算提案中的每項支出說明理由。
family: justification (n); justified (adj); justify A to B

en: the money used in a particular country
simple: I need local currency for the taxi.
simple_zh: 我需要當地貨幣來付計程車費。
toeic: The company hedges against changes in foreign currency rates.
toeic_zh: 公司對外幣匯率的變動進行避險。
family: currency (n); foreign currency; currency exchange; currently (adv)

en: a relationship between two numbers or amounts
simple: Our class has a ratio of two to one.
simple_zh: 男孩與女孩的比例是二比一。
toeic: The ratio of debt to equity has improved this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季負債與權益的比率已有改善。
family: ratio (n); debt ratio; in a ratio of; proportion (n)

en: to take money out of a bank account; to take something back
simple: I want to withdraw some cash.
toeic: Customers may withdraw up to five hundred dollars per day.
toeic_zh: 客戶每天最多可提領五百元。

en: a person whose job is to study information and explain it
simple: My uncle is a computer analyst.
toeic: A financial analyst reviewed the merger proposal before the meeting.
toeic_zh: 一位財務分析師在會議前審閱了併購提案。

en: pressure or stress that is hard to deal with
simple: Working late puts strain on my back.
simple_zh: 工作到很晚讓我的背吃不消。
toeic: The rising costs placed great strain on the small firm's finances.
toeic_zh: 成本上升對這家小公司的財務造成很大壓力。
family: strain (n/v); put a strain on; financial strain; strained (adj)

en: a large amount of money or valuable things
simple: He built his wealth slowly.
simple_zh: 他慢慢累積了他的財富。
toeic: The report examines how wealth is distributed across regions.
toeic_zh: 這份報告探討財富如何在各地區分配。
family: wealth (n); wealthy (adj); wealth management; a wealth of

en: the act of becoming involved to change a situation
simple: Quick intervention saved the project.
simple_zh: 迅速的介入挽救了這個專案。
toeic: Government intervention helped stabilize the housing market.
toeic_zh: 政府的干預有助於穩定房市。

en: correct and without mistakes
simple: The map is accurate.
toeic: Please ensure that the figures in the report are accurate.
toeic_zh: 請確保報告中的數字準確無誤。

en: something heavy or difficult that you must carry or deal with
simple: The bag is a burden on my back.
simple_zh: 這個袋子壓在我背上很沉重。
toeic: The new tax will place a heavy burden on small businesses.
toeic_zh: 新稅制將對小型企業造成沉重負擔。
family: burden (n/v); burdensome (adj); financial burden; ease the burden

en: money put into a bank or paid first to hold something
simple: I paid a deposit for the room.
simple_zh: 我為這個房間付了訂金。
toeic: A refundable deposit is required to reserve the conference hall.
toeic_zh: 預訂會議廳需要付一筆可退還的訂金。
family: deposit (n/v); depositor (n); security deposit; make a deposit

en: the act of becoming healthy or strong again
simple: The doctor expects a full recovery.
simple_zh: 醫生預期他會完全康復。
toeic: The company expects a strong recovery in sales next quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司預期下一季銷售將強勁復甦。

en: the importance or meaning of something
simple: I understand the significance of this day.
toeic: The manager explained the significance of the new tax regulation.
toeic_zh: 經理說明了新稅法的重要性。

en: to say what you think will happen in the future
simple: They forecast snow for tonight.
toeic: Analysts forecast a five percent rise in consumer spending.
toeic_zh: 分析師預測消費支出將成長百分之五。

en: the extra amount or space; the difference between cost and price
simple: Write notes in the margin.
toeic: Rising costs have reduced our profit margin this year.
toeic_zh: 成本上漲使我們今年的利潤率下降。
family: marginal (adj); profit margin; margin of error

en: a loan used to buy a home
simple: They pay the mortgage every month.
toeic: Lower interest rates have made it easier to get a mortgage.
toeic_zh: 較低的利率使申請房貸變得更容易。
family: mortgage loan; mortgage payment; take out a mortgage

en: the amount by which money spent is more than money earned
simple: The team has a deficit of ten points.
toeic: The company reported a budget deficit for the second year.
toeic_zh: 公司連續第二年公布預算赤字。
family: budget deficit; trade deficit; deficit of

en: a general rise in prices
simple: Inflation makes food more expensive.
toeic: High inflation has reduced consumers' purchasing power.
toeic_zh: 高通膨降低了消費者的購買力。

en: the amount of money spent
simple: Our weekly expenditure is too high.
simple_zh: 我們每週的開銷太高了。
toeic: The finance office reviews all capital expenditure each quarter.
toeic_zh: 財務部每季審查所有資本支出。

en: a share or interest in a business or a result
simple: He has a stake in the shop.
toeic: The investor holds a ten percent stake in the company.
toeic_zh: 這位投資人持有該公司百分之十的股份。
family: hold a stake in; stakeholder (n); at stake

en: a punishment or fine for breaking a rule or contract
simple: There is a penalty for late work.
toeic: A late payment penalty will be added to your bill.
toeic_zh: 逾期付款罰金將加到您的帳單上。

en: as a result of something
simple: He was sick, so consequently he stayed home.
simple_zh: 他生病了，所以只好待在家。
toeic: Sales fell sharply; consequently, the company cut its budget.
toeic_zh: 銷售額大幅下滑，因此公司削減了預算。

en: a person or company that offers a price to buy or do something
simple: The highest bidder won the painting.
simple_zh: 出價最高的人買下了那幅畫。
toeic: Only three bidders submitted proposals for the construction contract.
toeic_zh: 只有三家投標廠商提交了這項工程合約的提案。
family: bid (n/v); bidding (n); highest bidder; winning bidder

en: a company that makes cars
simple: The carmaker built a new plant.
simple_zh: 那家汽車製造商蓋了一座新工廠。
toeic: The carmaker announced that it would recall twenty thousand vehicles.
toeic_zh: 那家汽車製造商宣布將召回兩萬輛車。

en: cows and bulls kept on a farm
simple: The farmer has many cattle.
toeic: Rising feed prices have hurt farmers who raise cattle for beef.
toeic_zh: 飼料價格上漲使得飼養肉牛的農民受到打擊。

en: at a low price or low cost
simple: You can buy it cheaply online.
simple_zh: 你可以在網路上便宜買到。
toeic: The factory can produce these parts cheaply because of automation.
toeic_zh: 由於自動化，工廠能夠以低成本生產這些零件。

en: a printed paper that orders a bank to pay money
simple: I wrote a cheque for rent.
simple_zh: 我開了一張支票付房租。
toeic: Please make the cheque payable to the supplier and mail it today.
toeic_zh: 請開立以供應商為抬頭的支票並於今天寄出。
family: write/cash/bounce a cheque; cheque payable to; check (US spelling)

en: stated in or required by a legal agreement
simple: It is a contractual duty.
toeic: The supplier failed to meet its contractual obligations on delivery dates.
toeic_zh: 供應商未能履行合約規定的交貨日期義務。

en: the other person or company in a financial deal
simple: The counterparty has not paid yet.
toeic: Each counterparty must sign the agreement before the trade is settled.
toeic_zh: 每位交易對手都必須在交易結算前簽署協議。
family: counterpart (n); party (n); credit risk of a counterparty

en: a long-term loan certificate issued by a company, often unsecured
simple: He bought a debenture last year.
toeic: The company issued a debenture to raise funds for its overseas expansion.
toeic_zh: 公司發行債券來籌措海外擴張的資金。
family: issue a debenture; debenture holder; bond (n)

en: to express an amount of money in a particular currency
simple: The price is denominated in dollars.
toeic: All contracts with overseas buyers are denominated in euros.
toeic_zh: 所有與海外買家簽訂的合約都以歐元計價。
family: denomination (n); be denominated in sth; currency denomination

zh: 使轉向；轉移（資金、注意力）
en: to send something in a different direction or to a different use
simple: Police will divert traffic to another road.
simple_zh: 警察會把車流導向另一條路。
toeic: The company decided to divert funds from marketing to research.
toeic_zh: 公司決定把行銷經費轉用於研究。

en: a person, company or country that sells goods to other countries
simple: This country is a big exporter of rice.
simple_zh: 這個國家是稻米的主要出口國。
toeic: As a leading exporter of machinery, the firm ships to forty countries.
toeic_zh: 作為機械的主要出口商，這家公司的貨物銷往四十個國家。

en: a person, company or country that buys goods from other countries
simple: He works for a large importer.
simple_zh: 他在一家大型進口商工作。
toeic: The importer must pay customs duties before the goods are released.
toeic_zh: 進口商必須先繳交關稅，貨物才會放行。

en: a person or company that helps two sides make a deal
simple: He acted as an intermediary.
toeic: The agency serves as an intermediary between buyers and suppliers.
toeic_zh: 這家機構擔任買家與供應商之間的仲介。

en: able to be changed after discussion
simple: The price is negotiable, so ask him.
simple_zh: 價格可以談，所以問問他。
toeic: The starting salary is negotiable depending on the candidate's experience.
toeic_zh: 起薪可依應徵者的經驗而議定。

en: something that helps you know what will happen in the future
simple: Early sales are a good predictor.
simple_zh: 早期銷售是很好的預測指標。
toeic: Customer satisfaction is a strong predictor of repeat purchases.
toeic_zh: 顧客滿意度是重複購買的有力預測指標。

en: money paid before it is due or before getting the goods
simple: The shop asks for prepayment first.
simple_zh: 這家店要求先預付款項。
toeic: The supplier requires a prepayment of fifty percent before shipping the order.
toeic_zh: 供應商要求在出貨前先預付百分之五十的款項。

en: careful and sensible when making decisions, especially about money
simple: It is prudent to save some money.
toeic: A prudent manager reviews the budget before approving any new expenses.
toeic_zh: 審慎的經理會在核准任何新支出前先檢視預算。

en: to give people only a limited amount of something
simple: They ration water during the dry summer.
simple_zh: 乾燥的夏天他們限量供水。
toeic: The factory had to ration electricity during the peak season.
toeic_zh: 工廠在旺季時必須限量用電。

en: the act of paying back money you owe
simple: The monthly repayment is not high.
toeic: The bank offered a flexible repayment schedule for small businesses.
toeic_zh: 銀行為小型企業提供彈性的還款時程。

en: the selling of something that you have bought
simple: He bought the bike for resale.
simple_zh: 他買下這輛腳踏車是為了轉售。
toeic: Goods purchased for resale are recorded as inventory.
toeic_zh: 為轉售而購入的商品會記錄為存貨。
family: resell (v); reseller (n); resale price; resale value

en: a reduction in speed or activity
simple: There was a slowdown on the road.
toeic: A slowdown at the port delayed shipments of raw materials.
toeic_zh: 港口作業放緩，延誤了原料的出貨。
family: slow down (v phrase); economic slowdown; work slowdown

en: the act of using something well; how much of something is used
simple: Utilization of the gym is very low.
simple_zh: 健身房的使用率非常低。
toeic: Better utilization of warehouse space lowered storage costs.
toeic_zh: 更有效地利用倉庫空間降低了儲存成本。

en: a business that sells large amounts of goods to shops
simple: The shop buys fruit from a wholesaler.
simple_zh: 這家店向批發商買水果。
toeic: We negotiated lower prices directly with the wholesaler.
toeic_zh: 我們直接與批發商協商出較低的價格。

en: containing many things close together
simple: The fog is very dense today.
toeic: Heavy traffic in the dense downtown area delayed the delivery truck.
toeic_zh: 市中心人口稠密地區的塞車延誤了送貨卡車。

en: to a very great degree; in a way that is hard to believe
simple: The cake was incredibly good.
simple_zh: 這個蛋糕好吃得不可思議。
toeic: Our delivery team worked incredibly fast during the holiday rush.
toeic_zh: 我們的配送團隊在假期尖峰期間工作速度極快。

en: without any limit or end
simple: The sky seems infinite.
toeic: The platform offers infinite possibilities for customizing your orders.
toeic_zh: 這個平台提供無限的客製化訂單可能性。

en: a pen with a thick tip; something that shows a position
simple: I need a red marker.
simple_zh: 我需要一支紅色麥克筆。
toeic: Use a marker to label each box before shipping.
toeic_zh: 出貨前請用麥克筆標示每個箱子。

en: a system of signs or symbols used to write something
simple: Music has its own notation.
toeic: Check the notation on the shipping label before loading.
toeic_zh: 裝載前請核對運送標籤上的註記。

en: very simple or old-fashioned; at an early stage
simple: They used primitive tools.
toeic: The warehouse still relies on primitive inventory methods.
toeic_zh: 這間倉庫仍然依賴簡陋的庫存管理方法。

en: causing difficulty or trouble
simple: The old printer is problematic.
toeic: The supplier's late deliveries have become increasingly problematic.
toeic_zh: 供應商的延遲交貨問題越來越棘手。

en: easily affected or harmed by something
simple: Babies are susceptible to colds.
toeic: Imported goods are susceptible to damage during shipping.
toeic_zh: 進口貨物在運送過程中容易受損。

en: not completely
simple: The sky is partly cloudy today.
toeic: The delay was partly caused by a shortage of raw materials.
toeic_zh: 這次延誤有一部分是由原料短缺造成的。

en: related to the countryside rather than towns
simple: They live in a rural village.
toeic: The company plans to bring broadband service to rural communities.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃將寬頻服務帶到鄉村社區。

en: to give or send things to several people or places
simple: We distribute free water.
toeic: The company will distribute the product to retailers nationwide.
toeic_zh: 公司將把產品配送給全國的零售商。

en: the place or point where something starts
simple: What is the origin of this word?
toeic: The label shows the country of origin for every imported item.
toeic_zh: 標籤上標示了每項進口商品的原產國。

en: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement
simple: We must negotiate the price.
toeic: The union will negotiate a new contract with management next week.
toeic_zh: 工會下週將與資方協商新合約。

en: a company that provides goods to other businesses
simple: The supplier delivered the boxes.
simple_zh: 供應商送來了那些箱子。
toeic: We switched to a cheaper supplier to reduce our production costs.
toeic_zh: 我們換了較便宜的供應商以降低生產成本。

en: to limit what someone can do or have
simple: The rule will restrict parking here.
simple_zh: 這條規定會限制這裡的停車。
toeic: Company policy will restrict access to confidential files.
toeic_zh: 公司政策將限制機密檔案的存取。
family: restriction (n); restricted (adj); restrict A to B

en: to find where something came from or where it went
simple: Can you trace my package for me?
simple_zh: 你可以幫我追蹤我的包裹嗎？
toeic: The courier was able to trace the missing shipment within an hour.
toeic_zh: 快遞公司在一小時內就追查到遺失的貨件。

en: to leave something out or not allow it
simple: The price does not exclude tax.
simple_zh: 這個價格並沒有排除稅金。
toeic: The warranty will exclude damage caused by misuse.
toeic_zh: 保固不包含因使用不當造成的損壞。
family: exclusion (n); exclusive (adj); exclude A from B

en: something you must do because of a rule or promise
simple: I have an obligation to help.
toeic: The tenant has an obligation to pay rent on time.
toeic_zh: 房客有義務準時繳納租金。

en: a state of confusion or a medical problem
simple: The room was in complete disorder.
toeic: Shipping delays caused disorder in the warehouse this week.
toeic_zh: 運送延誤使倉庫本週陷入混亂。

en: an offer of a price for something or for a contract
simple: He made a bid for the old car.
toeic: Our firm submitted a bid for the highway construction project.
toeic_zh: 我們公司提交了公路建設案的投標書。
family: bid (n/v); submit a bid; winning bid; bidder (n)

en: coming after something else
simple: Subsequent classes will be shorter.
toeic: Subsequent orders will be shipped within three business days.
toeic_zh: 後續的訂單將在三個工作天內出貨。

en: an amount or number of something
simple: I bought a small quantity of rice.
toeic: Customers who order in large quantity receive free shipping.
toeic_zh: 大量訂購的客戶可享免運費。

en: a person or business that buys and sells goods
simple: He works for a car dealer.
simple_zh: 他在一家汽車經銷商工作。
toeic: The authorized dealer will provide a free inspection.
toeic_zh: 授權經銷商將提供免費檢查。

en: to say clearly and exactly what is needed
simple: Please specify the color you want.
toeic: The contract must specify the delivery date and payment terms.
toeic_zh: 合約必須明訂交貨日期與付款條件。
family: specification (n); specific (adj); specify A in B

en: needing something else or relying on it
simple: A baby is dependent on its parents.
toeic: Our delivery schedule is dependent on the supplier's shipment.
toeic_zh: 我們的交貨時程取決於供應商的出貨。

en: a person who buys something
simple: The buyer paid in cash.
toeic: The buyer requested a discount for ordering in bulk.
toeic_zh: 買方要求大量訂購的折扣。

en: to do what is needed or promised
simple: I will fulfill my promise.
toeic: We cannot fulfill the order until the shipment arrives.
toeic_zh: 在貨物抵達前，我們無法完成這筆訂單。

en: to try to deal with a problem
simple: We must tackle this problem now.
simple_zh: 我們現在必須處理這個問題。
toeic: The task force was formed to tackle delays in shipping.
toeic_zh: 成立工作小組是為了處理運送延誤問題。
family: tackle a problem; tackle an issue; tackle (n)

en: able to be trusted to work well
simple: This car is very reliable.
toeic: We need a reliable supplier who can deliver on time.
toeic_zh: 我們需要能準時交貨的可靠供應商。

en: used to say that something is likely to be true
simple: She is presumably at home now.
toeic: The shipment is presumably still waiting at customs.
toeic_zh: 這批貨大概還在海關等候。

en: without being affected by something
simple: We play regardless of the weather.
simple_zh: 不管天氣如何，我們都會比賽。
toeic: Orders will ship on time regardless of the destination.
toeic_zh: 無論目的地為何，訂單都會準時出貨。

en: an amount that is more than is needed or allowed
simple: There is an excess of water here.
toeic: Any excess inventory will be sold at a discount.
toeic_zh: 任何過剩的庫存都將折價出售。
family: in excess of; excessive (adj); excess baggage

en: legal responsibility for something, or an amount of money owed
simple: Who has liability for the damage?
toeic: The company accepts no liability for lost personal items.
toeic_zh: 本公司對遺失的個人物品概不負責。

en: a person or thing that takes the place of another
simple: Use milk as a substitute.
toeic: We will find a substitute for the sick team member today.
toeic_zh: 我們今天會為生病的組員找一位代理人。

en: something added to improve or complete another thing
simple: She takes a vitamin supplement.
toeic: The report includes a supplement with additional sales data.
toeic_zh: 報告附有一份包含額外銷售數據的補充資料。

en: the state of owning something
simple: Ownership of the house passed to her son.
simple_zh: 房子的所有權轉給了她的兒子。
toeic: The ownership of the company changed hands after the merger.
toeic_zh: 合併之後，公司的所有權易主了。
family: owner (n); own (v); ownership stake; public ownership

en: to become less; to politely say no
simple: Sales decline in the summer.
toeic: Profits continued to decline despite the company's cost-cutting measures.
toeic_zh: 儘管公司採取節約成本措施，利潤仍持續下滑。

en: another choice that can be used instead
simple: Tea is an alternative to coffee.
toeic: We need to find an alternative to the current supplier.
toeic_zh: 我們需要找到目前供應商的替代方案。

en: an organized plan, often a large one
simple: The shop has a new discount scheme.
simple_zh: 這家店有新的折扣方案。
toeic: The government introduced a pension scheme for small business employees.
toeic_zh: 政府為小型企業員工推出了一項退休金方案。

en: a time when something happens later than planned
simple: The rain caused a long delay.
simple_zh: 下雨造成了長時間的延誤。
toeic: A delay in the shipment was caused by a shortage of containers.
toeic_zh: 貨櫃短缺造成了貨物出貨延誤。

en: when compared with other things
simple: The test was relatively easy.
toeic: Sales stayed relatively stable despite the economic slowdown.
toeic_zh: 儘管經濟放緩，銷售額仍相對穩定。

en: the money a company earns from its business
simple: The shop's revenue went up.
toeic: Annual revenue grew by eight percent last fiscal year.
toeic_zh: 去年會計年度的年營收成長了百分之八。
family: annual revenue; revenue stream; tax revenue

en: to be different or change from one case to another
simple: Prices vary from shop to shop.
toeic: Delivery times vary depending on the destination and season.
toeic_zh: 送貨時間會依目的地和季節而異。

en: the act of bringing goods to a person or place
simple: The delivery arrives at noon.
toeic: Please confirm the delivery date before we place the order.
toeic_zh: 下訂單前請先確認交貨日期。
family: deliver (v); deliverer (n); delivery date; free delivery

en: a price that a company says it will charge
simple: Please send me a quote.
toeic: We requested a quote from three different suppliers.
toeic_zh: 我們向三家不同的供應商索取報價。
family: quote (v); quotation (n); get a quote; free quote

en: to put goods into a vehicle or data into a computer
simple: They load boxes onto the truck.
toeic: Workers load the containers onto the ship before midnight.
toeic_zh: 工人在午夜前把貨櫃裝上船。
family: load (n) 貨物; loader (n); unload (v); overload (v)

en: to get something by buying it or by effort
simple: She wants to acquire new skills.
toeic: The group plans to acquire a smaller rival next quarter.
toeic_zh: 集團計劃在下一季收購一家較小的對手公司。
family: acquisition (n); acquire a company; acquire skills

en: money you pay for a service or entry
simple: The entry fee is ten dollars.
toeic: A small fee will be charged for late registration.
toeic_zh: 逾期報名將酌收少許費用。

en: to have enough money or time to do something
simple: I cannot afford a new car.
toeic: Few small firms can afford to advertise on national television.
toeic_zh: 很少有小公司負擔得起在全國性電視上打廣告。

en: to judge the quality or value of something
simple: The teacher will assess my work today.
simple_zh: 老師今天會評估我的作業。
toeic: Inspectors will assess the damage before the insurance claim is approved.
toeic_zh: 在保險理賠核准前，檢查人員會先評估損害程度。

en: a promise or strong dedication to do something
simple: He keeps every commitment he makes.
toeic: The manager praised the team for its commitment to quality.
toeic_zh: 經理稱讚團隊對品質的堅持。
family: commit (v); committed (adj); commitment to; make a commitment

en: in a way that cannot be avoided
simple: Big cars are not necessarily better.
toeic: Higher prices do not necessarily lead to higher profits.
toeic_zh: 價格提高不一定會帶來更高的利潤。

en: a certificate of debt sold by a government or company; a close link
simple: The city sold a bond to build the bridge.
simple_zh: 市政府發行債券來建造這座橋。
toeic: The corporation issued a bond to raise funds for expansion.
toeic_zh: 這家企業發行債券以籌集擴張資金。
family: bond issue; government bond; bond (v); bondholder

en: a group of linked shops; connected links; a linked series
simple: This coffee chain has many shops.
simple_zh: 這家連鎖咖啡店有很多分店。
toeic: Disruptions in the supply chain delayed the product launch.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷使產品上市延後。
family: supply chain; chain store; chain of command; chain reaction

en: a piece of paper or cloth that gives information about a product
simple: Read the label on the bottle.
toeic: Each package must carry a label showing the shipping address.
toeic_zh: 每個包裹都必須貼上標明收件地址的標籤。

en: to sell goods to another country
simple: Japan will export cars to Europe.
simple_zh: 日本會把汽車出口到歐洲。
toeic: Our factory plans to export medical equipment to over thirty countries.
toeic_zh: 我們的工廠計劃把醫療設備出口到三十多個國家。

en: the meaning of a word or term
simple: What is the definition of this word?
toeic: The contract's definition of confidential information is quite broad.
toeic_zh: 合約中對機密資訊的定義相當廣泛。

en: the act of looking at how things are alike or different
simple: Make a comparison between the two phones.
simple_zh: 把這兩支手機做個比較。
toeic: A price comparison showed that our rival charges ten percent more.
toeic_zh: 價格比較顯示我們的競爭對手多收百分之十。
family: compare (v); comparative (adj); comparable (adj); in comparison with

en: a belief that something will happen
simple: The trip met my expectation.
simple_zh: 這趟旅行符合我的期待。
toeic: Quarterly sales exceeded our expectations by a wide margin.
toeic_zh: 季度銷售額大幅超出我們的預期。

en: to bring goods into a country to sell
simple: We import tea from India.
toeic: The retailer will import furniture directly from overseas factories.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商將直接從海外工廠進口家具。

en: the act of choosing, or a group of things to choose from
simple: The shop has a big selection of tea.
simple_zh: 這家店有很多種茶可選。
toeic: The company offers a wide selection of office furniture.
toeic_zh: 這家公司提供種類繁多的辦公家具。
family: select (v); selective (adj); a wide selection of

en: shared by two or more people or groups
simple: They made a joint decision about the trip.
simple_zh: 他們共同決定了這趟旅行。
toeic: The two firms announced a joint venture to build solar panels.
toeic_zh: 這兩家公司宣布合資成立事業，生產太陽能板。

en: an important job or the main purpose of an organization
simple: The astronauts have a difficult mission.
simple_zh: 太空人有一項艱難的任務。
toeic: Our mission is to provide affordable healthcare to every community.
toeic_zh: 我們的使命是為每個社區提供負擔得起的醫療照護。

en: a first version of a piece of writing
simple: I wrote a draft of my letter.
toeic: Please send me the draft of the contract by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前把合約草案寄給我。
family: draft (v); first draft; draft a proposal

en: to suggest something without saying it directly
simple: His smile seems to imply that he is happy.
simple_zh: 他的笑容似乎暗示他很開心。
toeic: The low turnout may imply that customers are losing interest.
toeic_zh: 出席人數偏低可能意味著客戶正在失去興趣。

en: good enough to win against others, or involving competition
simple: The shop has very competitive prices.
simple_zh: 這家店的價格很有競爭力。
toeic: We offer a competitive salary and a full benefits package.
toeic_zh: 我們提供具競爭力的薪資及完整的福利方案。

en: in a way that works well and gives the result you want
simple: She uses her time effectively.
toeic: The new software helps us communicate effectively with clients.
toeic_zh: 新軟體幫助我們與客戶有效溝通。
family: effective (adj); effectiveness (n); work effectively; use effectively

en: a formal discussion to reach an agreement
simple: The negotiation lasted two hours.
toeic: The contract negotiation will continue until both sides agree on pricing.
toeic_zh: 合約談判將持續到雙方對價格達成共識為止。

en: to explain exactly what something means
simple: Please define this word for me.
simple_zh: 請幫我解釋這個字的意思。
toeic: The contract clearly defines each party's duties.
toeic_zh: 合約明確規定了各方的職責。

en: to buy something
simple: I want to purchase a new phone.
toeic: Customers who purchase two items receive a ten percent discount.
toeic_zh: 購買兩件商品的顧客可享九折優惠。
family: purchaser (n); purchasing (n); purchase order; proof of purchase

en: the tools and machines needed for a job
simple: The gym has a lot of equipment.
simple_zh: 這間健身房有很多器材。
toeic: All office equipment must be checked once a year.
toeic_zh: 所有辦公設備必須每年檢查一次。
family: equip (v); equipped (adj); office equipment; safety equipment

en: to take goods to a person or place
simple: They deliver pizza to our house.
simple_zh: 他們把披薩送到我們家。
toeic: The vendor promised to deliver the order by Thursday.
toeic_zh: 供應商承諾在週四前交貨。
family: delivery (n); deliverable (n); deliver a speech; on-time delivery

en: to bring things together, or to get something from a place
simple: I like to collect old coins.
toeic: Please collect your badge at the front desk.
toeic_zh: 請到櫃檯領取您的識別證。
family: collection (n); collector (n); collect payment; collect data

en: something a person or company can use, such as money or time
simple: Water is an important resource.
toeic: We lack the resources to finish on time.
toeic_zh: 我們缺乏資源，無法準時完成。
family: resourceful (adj); human resources; natural resources; resource allocation

en: the main reason or system on which something is done
simple: We meet on a weekly basis.
toeic: Staff are paid on an hourly basis.
toeic_zh: 員工按時薪計酬。
family: basic (adj); basically (adv); base (v); on a regular basis

en: physical activity, or a task that gives practice
simple: I do exercise every morning.
toeic: Regular exercise reduces stress and improves staff morale.
toeic_zh: 規律運動能減輕壓力並提升員工士氣。
family: exercise (v); exercise caution; exercise a right; exercise routine

en: to show or tell something that was hidden
simple: He will reveal the secret tomorrow.
simple_zh: 他明天會揭開這個祕密。
toeic: The survey results reveal that customers want faster service.
toeic_zh: 調查結果顯示顧客想要更快速的服務。
family: revelation (n); revealing (adj); reveal details; reveal the truth

en: the ability of a business to compete successfully
simple: Our competitiveness is growing every year.
simple_zh: 我們的競爭力逐年成長。
toeic: Lower labor costs improved the competitiveness of the manufacturer overseas.
toeic_zh: 較低的勞動成本提升了這家製造商在海外的競爭力。

en: to limit what someone or something can do
simple: Low funds constrain our growth.
simple_zh: 資金不足限制了我們的成長。
toeic: A tight budget may constrain the department's hiring plans this year.
toeic_zh: 預算吃緊可能會限制該部門今年的招聘計畫。

en: happening in regular repeating patterns
simple: Tourism is a cyclical business.
simple_zh: 旅遊業是有週期性的行業。
toeic: Demand in the housing market is highly cyclical and follows economic trends.
toeic_zh: 房屋市場的需求具高度週期性，並隨經濟趨勢變動。

en: a factor that decides what will happen
simple: Price is a key determinant of sales.
simple_zh: 價格是銷售的關鍵決定因素。
toeic: Customer loyalty is a major determinant of the firm's long-term profit.
toeic_zh: 顧客忠誠度是公司長期獲利的重要決定因素。
family: determine (v); determination (n); key determinant of sth

en: to take the place of someone or something; to force out of a place
simple: Cars displace horses in the city.
toeic: Automation may displace workers in the assembly department.
toeic_zh: 自動化可能會取代組裝部門的員工。

en: the act of creating a plan; the exact mix of parts in a product
simple: The formulation of a plan takes time.
toeic: The formulation of this cream was tested for two years.
toeic_zh: 這款乳霜的配方經過兩年的測試。

en: to damage something or make it less effective
simple: Noise can impair your sleep.
toeic: Poor communication may impair the team's ability to meet deadlines.
toeic_zh: 溝通不良可能損害團隊如期完成工作的能力。

en: the failure to work in a way that saves time, money or effort
simple: The slow system shows inefficiency.
simple_zh: 緩慢的系統顯示出效率不彰。
toeic: Paperwork leads to inefficiency in the accounting department.
toeic_zh: 文書作業造成會計部門的效率低落。

en: the act of making something as large as possible
simple: The shop wants profit maximization this year.
simple_zh: 這家店今年想要利潤最大化。
toeic: Profit maximization remains the main goal of the sales department.
toeic_zh: 利潤最大化仍是業務部門的主要目標。

en: to begin or start from a place or cause
simple: Many good ideas originate in small teams.
simple_zh: 許多好點子源自小團隊。
toeic: The shipping error appears to originate from a mistake in the warehouse system.
toeic_zh: 這次出貨錯誤似乎起因於倉儲系統中的一個失誤。

en: to decide or fix something before it happens
simple: We cannot predetermine the final result.
simple_zh: 我們無法預先決定最後的結果。
toeic: The committee will predetermine the budget limits before the hiring begins.
toeic_zh: 委員會會在開始招募前預先訂定預算上限。

en: to push someone gently to make them act
simple: I need to prod him to finish.
toeic: The manager had to prod the vendor to deliver the parts on time.
toeic_zh: 經理得催促廠商準時交付零件。

en: related to the quality of something, not the amount
simple: We need qualitative feedback from users.
simple_zh: 我們需要使用者的質性回饋。
toeic: The survey includes both quantitative data and qualitative comments from customers.
toeic_zh: 問卷同時包含量化資料與顧客的質性意見。

en: extra support that makes something stronger
simple: The old bridge needs reinforcement.
toeic: The warehouse roof required structural reinforcement before the winter storms.
toeic_zh: 在冬季風暴來臨前，倉庫屋頂需要進行結構加固。

en: to copy a real situation using a computer or model
simple: The game can simulate real flying.
simple_zh: 這個遊戲可以模擬真實的飛行。
toeic: The software can simulate how the new assembly line will perform.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體可以模擬新組裝線的運作表現。

en: to make things follow the same rules or size
simple: We should standardize the size of boxes.
simple_zh: 我們應該統一箱子的尺寸。
toeic: The plant will standardize its procedures across all locations.
toeic_zh: 工廠將統一所有據點的作業程序。

en: the act of using one thing instead of another
simple: The coach made a substitution at halftime.
simple_zh: 教練在中場休息時換了人。
toeic: Any substitution of materials must be approved by the engineer.
toeic_zh: 任何材料替換都必須經過工程師核准。
family: substitute (v/n); substitute for; substitution of A for B

en: the degree to which something changes or is different
simple: The weather has a lot of variability.
toeic: High variability in demand makes production planning difficult.
toeic_zh: 需求的高度變動使生產規劃變得困難。

en: very serious or severe
simple: He has an acute pain in his back.
toeic: The plant faces an acute shortage of steel components.
toeic_zh: 工廠面臨鋼製零件嚴重短缺的問題。

en: using only two numbers, 0 and 1, or having two parts
simple: Computers use binary numbers.
toeic: The software converts each file into binary code before transmission.
toeic_zh: 軟體會在傳輸前將每個檔案轉換成二進位碼。
family: binary code; binary system; binary choice

en: an idea or understanding of something
simple: He has a clear conception of the plan.
simple_zh: 他對這個計畫有清楚的概念。
toeic: From conception to launch, the product took about two years to develop.
toeic_zh: 這項產品從構想到上市大約花了兩年的時間開發。

en: a part that joins two things together
simple: This connector fits the cable.
simple_zh: 這個連接頭適合這條線。
toeic: The technician replaced a faulty connector on the main server.
toeic_zh: 技術人員更換了主伺服器上有故障的連接器。

en: to use something carefully so that it lasts longer
simple: We should conserve water at home.
simple_zh: 我們在家應該節約用水。
toeic: The factory installed new machines to conserve energy and cut costs.
toeic_zh: 工廠安裝了新機器以節約能源並降低成本。

en: to make something worse in quality or value
simple: Heat can degrade the old paper.
toeic: Poor storage may degrade the quality of the stored products.
toeic_zh: 不良的儲存方式可能會降低庫存產品的品質。

en: related to size or measurement in space
simple: This is a three dimensional model.
toeic: A two dimensional drawing was shown to the client before production.
toeic_zh: 生產前向客戶展示了一張二維圖。

en: related to the relationship between living things and nature
simple: We care about ecological problems.
toeic: The plant must pass an ecological review before it begins production.
toeic_zh: 這座工廠在開始生產前必須通過生態評估。

en: the act of removing something completely
simple: The elimination of waste saves money.
toeic: The elimination of unnecessary steps improved efficiency in the assembly line.
toeic_zh: 消除不必要的步驟提升了裝配線的效率。

en: to send out light, heat, gas or sound
simple: The old car can emit smoke.
toeic: New regulations limit how much carbon a plant can emit each year.
toeic_zh: 新法規限制工廠每年可排放的碳量。

en: a liquid or gas that can flow
simple: Drink more fluid when it is hot.
toeic: The machine needs cooling fluid to run safely during production.
toeic_zh: 這台機器需要冷卻液才能在生產期間安全運轉。

en: the number of times something happens
simple: The incidence of colds is high.
toeic: The factory reported a lower incidence of accidents after the safety training.
toeic_zh: 安全訓練之後，工廠回報事故發生率降低了。

en: relating to light or sight
simple: I visit an optical shop.
toeic: The factory installs optical sensors to detect defects on the line.
toeic_zh: 工廠安裝光學感測器來偵測生產線上的瑕疵。

en: a large place where water is stored
simple: The reservoir is full of water.
toeic: The plant draws cooling water from a nearby reservoir.
toeic_zh: 工廠從附近的水庫取用冷卻用水。

en: a small amount of something left after the rest is gone
simple: Wash off the residue.
toeic: The inspector found chemical residue on the machine parts.
toeic_zh: 檢查員在機器零件上發現了化學殘留物。

en: not harmed by something; unwilling to accept change
simple: This coat is water resistant.
toeic: The new coating is resistant to heat and corrosion.
toeic_zh: 新塗層耐熱且抗腐蝕。

en: to press and move your hand or a cloth on something
simple: Rub the table with a cloth.
toeic: Technicians must rub the lens with a clean cloth before each inspection.
toeic_zh: 技術人員每次檢查前都必須用乾淨的布擦拭鏡頭。

en: a small amount or example used for testing
simple: The doctor took a specimen.
toeic: The lab will test each specimen before the product is approved.
toeic_zh: 產品核准前，實驗室會檢驗每一份樣本。

en: related to heat or temperature
simple: I wear thermal socks in winter.
toeic: The factory installed a thermal sensor to monitor machine temperature.
toeic_zh: 工廠安裝了熱感應器來監測機器溫度。

en: the distance between two opposite surfaces of something
simple: Check the thickness of the paper.
toeic: The engineers measured the thickness of each steel plate before shipping.
toeic_zh: 工程師在出貨前測量了每塊鋼板的厚度。

en: to make cloth by crossing threads over and under each other
simple: They weave baskets by hand.
toeic: The workshop will weave traditional fabric for our new product line.
toeic_zh: 工坊將為我們的新產品系列編織傳統布料。

en: the amount of something that a person or factory produces
simple: The factory doubled its output.
simple_zh: 這間工廠把產量增加了一倍。
toeic: Monthly output fell by five percent because of the equipment failure.
toeic_zh: 由於設備故障，月產量下降了百分之五。

en: the order in which things follow each other
simple: Put the cards in sequence.
toeic: Follow this sequence of steps to complete the online registration.
toeic_zh: 請依照這一連串的步驟完成線上註冊。

en: one level of something that has several levels
simple: The cake has three layers.
toeic: The new policy adds another layer of approval to every purchase.
toeic_zh: 新政策為每筆採購增加了另一層核准程序。
family: layer of; a layer of management; multilayered (adj)

en: to keep something apart from other things
simple: They isolate sick people from others.
simple_zh: 他們把生病的人和其他人隔離。
toeic: Engineers worked to isolate the cause of the equipment failure.
toeic_zh: 工程師努力找出設備故障的原因。
family: isolation (n); isolated (adj); isolate A from B

en: to get rid of something completely
simple: We must eliminate waste in the kitchen.
simple_zh: 我們必須消除廚房裡的浪費。
toeic: The new system will eliminate the need for paper forms.
toeic_zh: 新系統將不再需要紙本表格。
family: elimination (n); eliminate A from B; eliminate errors

en: a set of rules or amounts for making or calculating something
simple: The teacher wrote a formula on the board.
simple_zh: 老師在黑板上寫了一個公式。
toeic: The factory changed the formula to lower production costs.
toeic_zh: 工廠改了配方以降低生產成本。

en: to change something into a different form
simple: I want to convert dollars to euros.
toeic: The plant will convert waste into usable energy.
toeic_zh: 這座工廠會把廢棄物轉化為可用的能源。
family: conversion (n); convertible (adj); convert A into B

zh: 至關重要的；必不可少的
en: extremely important and necessary
simple: Water is vital for life.
toeic: Quality control is vital to our production process.
toeic_zh: 品質管制對我們的生產流程至關重要。

en: a showing of how something works
simple: We watched a cooking demonstration.
toeic: The sales team will give a product demonstration at the trade fair.
toeic_zh: 業務團隊將在貿易展上進行產品示範。

en: a new idea, method or invention
simple: Smartphones are a great innovation.
simple_zh: 智慧型手機是很棒的創新。
toeic: Innovation is essential for staying ahead of competitors.
toeic_zh: 創新對於領先競爭對手至關重要。

en: the ability to work well without wasting time or money
simple: Good tools improve our efficiency.
simple_zh: 好的工具能提高我們的效率。
toeic: The new system will improve efficiency in the billing department.
toeic_zh: 新系統將提升帳務部門的效率。

en: to keep something going over time; to suffer
simple: We cannot sustain this pace.
simple_zh: 我們無法維持這個速度。
toeic: The company must sustain growth despite rising raw material costs.
toeic_zh: 儘管原料成本上漲，公司仍必須維持成長。

en: going in the same direction; very similar
simple: The two roads are parallel.
toeic: The firm ran two parallel projects to save time.
toeic_zh: 公司同時進行兩個並行的專案以節省時間。
family: parallel (adj/n/v); in parallel; parallel to; unparalleled (adj)

en: how often something happens
simple: The frequency of buses is low here.
toeic: The frequency of equipment failures has dropped this year.
toeic_zh: 今年設備故障的頻率已經下降。

en: following the usual or traditional way
simple: He likes conventional music.
toeic: Online shopping is cutting into sales at conventional stores.
toeic_zh: 網購正在侵蝕傳統商店的銷售額。

en: completely correct in every detail
simple: I need the exact time.
toeic: Please confirm the exact amount before issuing the invoice.
toeic_zh: 開立發票前請確認確切金額。

en: in an exact way
simple: The train leaves precisely at noon.
toeic: The assembly line must be calibrated precisely to avoid defects.
toeic_zh: 生產線必須精確校準以避免瑕疵。

en: related to the testing of medicine on patients
simple: She joined a clinical test last year.
simple_zh: 她去年參加了一項臨床試驗。
toeic: The pharmaceutical firm completed the clinical trial ahead of schedule.
toeic_zh: 這家製藥公司提前完成了臨床試驗。

en: the ability to do something
simple: The robot has the capability to walk.
simple_zh: 這個機器人有行走的能力。
toeic: The new plant will double our production capability.
toeic_zh: 新工廠將使我們的生產能力加倍。

en: the size or amount found by measuring
simple: Write down the measurement of the table.
toeic: Accurate measurement of each part is essential for quality control.
toeic_zh: 精確測量每個零件對品質管制至關重要。

en: to change something a little
simple: I will modify my plan.
toeic: Engineers had to modify the design to meet safety standards.
toeic_zh: 工程師必須修改設計以符合安全標準。
family: modification (n); modified (adj); modify A to B

en: to experience a process, change, or test
simple: Many people undergo a health check each year.
simple_zh: 許多人每年都接受健康檢查。
toeic: The factory will undergo a full safety inspection next month.
toeic_zh: 這間工廠下個月將接受全面的安全檢查。

en: happening without stopping
simple: We heard continuous noise all night.
simple_zh: 我們整晚都聽到不斷的噪音。
toeic: The plant requires continuous monitoring of its temperature.
toeic_zh: 這座工廠需要持續監控溫度。

en: exact and correct in every detail
simple: I need the precise time.
toeic: Please give us a precise estimate of the repair costs.
toeic_zh: 請給我們維修費用的精確估價。

en: to remove unwanted things from a liquid, light, or group
simple: We filter the water first.
toeic: The software can filter emails by sender or subject.
toeic_zh: 這套軟體可依寄件者或主旨篩選電子郵件。

en: how likely it is that something will happen
simple: There is a high probability of rain.
toeic: The probability of a delay increases during the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 假期期間延誤的可能性會提高。

en: to be made up of particular parts
simple: The team will comprise five people.
simple_zh: 這個團隊將由五個人組成。
toeic: The board comprises seven members from different departments.
toeic_zh: 董事會由來自不同部門的七名成員組成。
family: be comprised of; comprehensive (adj); comprise vs compose

en: to stop something for a period of time
simple: The school will suspend the class today.
simple_zh: 學校今天將暫停這堂課。
toeic: The company decided to suspend production until the safety check is complete.
